articleTitle: A Study on Named Entity Recognition of Chinese Social Text Based on ERNIE and Lexicon Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a task in natural language processing that focuses on identifying and categorizing significant entities within a body of text. The efficiency of this process has a ripple effect on subsequent operations, including tasks like extracting information, answering questions, and translating languages, among others. When pitted against English's approach to named entity recognition, A significant hurdle in the recognition of Chinese named entities is the unpredictability inherent in Chinese linguistic structures, coupled with the diverse and mutable ways in which words are strung together to form phrases, especially in more colloquial datasets, such as social texts. Dealing with these complex datasets requires more accurate algorithmic models, and semantic elements, including the broader context, must be factored in. As a result, the article introduces an advanced Chinese named entity recognition model known as LE-ERNIE, which incorporates lexicon enrichment.Lexicon enhancement, on the other hand, aims to incorporate information that cannot be directly mined from the text through an external dictionary. By employing an adaptive coding mechanism, the model merges lexicon details into its encoding phase, facilitating the assimilation of profound lexical insights within the pre-established framework of ERNIE's language processing capabilities. The final comparative experiments, based on the Weibo NER dataset, showed the following results: ① Compared to the ERNIE model without lexicon enhancement, the proposed LE-ERNIE model achieved an improvement of approximately 0.95% in F1-score. ② Compared to other models with lexicon enhancement, the LE-ERNIE model demonstrated an F1-score improvement ranging from 0.71% to 12.67%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Two-dimensional Path Optimization Algorithm Based on Dijkstra Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the limitations of the traditional Dijkstra algorithm in two-dimensional path optimization problems, this article uses ant colony algorithm to optimize the Dijkstra algorithm, solving the limitations of the Dijkstra algorithm that requires path optimization in finite node graphs and is difficult to traverse the best path that matches actual situations. Generate initial path through Dijkstra algorithm and allocate pheromones to the initial path through ant colony algorithm for iterative calculation, ultimately converging to the optimal path. Through MATLAB software simulation, the optimized Dijkstra-ant algorithm was compared with the original algorithm, optimized algorithm resulted in a better path.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Robust Control of Multi-channel Closed-Loop Supply Chain with Time-Varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: A dynamic pattern is developed for a multi-channel CLSC (closed-loop supply chain) system to solve the FRC (fuzzy robust control) issue of a multi-channel CLSC. Time-varying delays during product recycling and remanufacturing in live e-commerce are taken into consideration. The T-S (Takagi Sugeno) FRC method is employed to mitigate the information of time-varying delays and demand fluctuation interference caused by recycling and remanufacturing. Through MATLAB simulation software, it is demonstrated that the method effectively guarantees the system's dynamic performance while mitigating the bullwhip effect.

articleTitle: Research on Clustering Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm to reduce network energy consumption and extend network life cycle, the methods such as adding supplementary nodes, improving the probability of cluster node becoming cluster head, and improving the inter-cluster transmission method are mainly utilized. The problems of node energy loss too fast, network energy consumption imbalance, and energy consumption from cluster head to base station are solved. Simulation results show that the new algorithm proposed in this paper improves 17 times and 28.3% in data transmission, 88.5% and 8.7% in prolonging the network lifecycle, and 62.4% and 35.9% in reducing the energy loss of the network compared with the LEACH algorithm and DEEC algorithm.

articleTitle: Masked Face Inpainting Using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Image inpainting in computer vision is a challenging task, as most existing approaches are trained for certain mask distributions, which limiting their generalization capability when confronted with unknown mask types. However, rather than producing semantically significant texture, training with pixel-level and perceptual losses frequently results in the extrapolation of basic texture in absent areas. In this paper, we propose an image inpainting approach based on Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM). We utilize a pretrained unconditional DDPM as a generative prior. We alter the generative process of the model, enabling accelerated resampling for unknown regions based on known information from the given image. Since our approach does not involve any adjustments or modifications to the DDPM network itself, it can handle any form of mask and generate high-quality and diverse outcomes. The CelebA-HQ dataset experimental results show that our approach produces state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Research on Prohibited Item Detection Algorithms in X-ray Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address challenges such as target overlap, complex backgrounds, and missed detections of small objects in X-ray image contraband detection, we propose an improved YOLOv7-based contraband detection model. Firstly, in the feature fusion stage, we introduce a Coordinate Attention (CA) module to enhance the network's ability to extract essential features, mitigating background interference caused by overlaps. Secondly, we design an MPC2F module to reduce feature loss and enhance the network's capability to detect small objects. Lastly, to expedite model convergence and enhance its generalization, we employ the AdaN adaptive momentum optimizer during training.The improved model achieves an average detection accuracy of 93.4% and 84.2% on the SiXary and HiXary contraband datasets, respectively, representing a 1.3% and 1.4% improvement over the baseline YOLOv7 model. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model effectively enhances contraband detection performance in X-ray images compared to existing mainstream networks, significantly reducing missed detection rates caused by occlusion and small target issues.

articleTitle: Garbage classification recognition based on improved YOLOv8 model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The use of intelligent garbage classification methods and devices for waste sorting is set to become the future trend in waste management. With the development of high-precision image recognition algorithms, research in intelligent garbage classification has gradually matured. The core lies in utilizing image recognition technology to analyze garbage image information, thereby surpassing the limitations of manual sorting and achieving higher standards of speed and accuracy. This paper proposes a target detection scheme based on the introduction of the C2f_RepGhost module into YOLOv8, aiming to construct a model system for efficient garbage identification and classification. Thanks to its streamlined design and real-time response characteristics, this model can operate efficiently on platforms such as smart mobile devices, enabling real-time intelligent automatic classification of various types of waste.

articleTitle: The Study on Laser-induced Breakdown Spectroscopy for Real-time Monitoring the Laser Cleaning of Carbon Fiber Plate
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) was utilized to assess the laser removal degree of epoxy resin coating on carbon fiber plate. The experiment was conducted with two Nd: YAG lasers. One laser cleans the sample, the other laser is used to produce plasma from epoxy resin which is attached to the surface of carbon fiber plate. The laser cleaning process was monitored by measuring the plasma spectra when removing epoxy resin coatings. The result showed that the removal depth of epoxy resin coating increased with the laser pulses number, the plasma emission of the elements decreases. The electron density and plasma temperature of characteristic elements also decreased with the laser cleaning numbers. This research can provide technical support for LIBS to monitor the laser cleaning process online and realize automatic and intelligent laser cleaning.

articleTitle: Research on Short-term Load Forecasting Method Based on ANFIS-BPNN-LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the basis of safe and orderly dispatching of power system, A BP neural network (back propagation), adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and least squares support vector machine (LEast-squares) are proposed Load forecasting method (ANFIS-BPNN-LSSVM) combined with supportvector machines. Through the simulation experiment of load data in a certain area, the weight coefficient model optimized by BP neural network, adaptive neural network, least square support vector machine and combined prediction method is compared and analyzed. The results show that the ANFIS-BPNN-LSSVM model has better prediction accuracy than the single method, and also improves the robustness of the combined model, which provides method basis for energy scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Laser Measurement Solution Method of Fuze Parts Diameter
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the safety and reliability of the fuze system, a diameter measurement system of fuze parts based on laser projection method is proposed in this paper, which can effectively collect and process the projection edge information of the measured parts. According to the position relationship of two groups of mutually perpendicular laser measurement units in the system and the three relative position relationships between the center of the part and the center of the measurement system, the corresponding mathematical solution formula is derived, and the superiority of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Rectifying Fisheye Image
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Fisheye lens cameras offer a significantly wider field of view compared to conventional cameras. However, they also introduce geometric distortions and distorted shapes in captured images. This paper presents a self-supervised fisheye correction method based on convolutional neural networks. The method is trained using a readily available urban landscape roadway dataset and leverages the inherent stability of pixel coordinate relationships after uniform distortion to design an effective correction model. During the training process, distorted images are synthesized from the original undistorted images, and the predicted parameters are utilized to correct fisheye images. Furthermore, the loss function is constructed using the geometric mean of the Hough transform, and the entire model is trained with the assistance of the slope loss of the straight line, thus achieving an end-to-end framework. Experimental results demonstrate that our method provides superior performance in correcting real-world in-vehicle images, outperforming similar approaches in terms of correction accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control Strategy for PMSM Current Loop Based on Parameter Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This study explores the importance and impact of current loop controller parameters in permanent magnet synchronous motor control systems. Parameter variations during motor operation, such as changes in temperature and operating current, can directly affect the control performance of the current loop and the overall stability of the system. This underscores the critical role of real-time and accurate motor parameter acquisition in current loop control to enhance controller dynamic performance and system stability. On the other hand, adaptive control methods offer a robust strategy to effectively handle variations in system parameters and external disturbances, demonstrating their value and extensive application potential in practical scenarios. Therefore, conducting research on adaptive control strategies for permanent magnet synchronous motors based on precise system parameters is of practical significance.

articleTitle: Time-Frequency Analysis of Underwater Explosion Signal by CEEMDAN-Hilbert Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper studies the characteristics of the underwater explosion signal characteristics and analysis of it by proposing the CEEMDAN-Hilbert method. The research can provide the theoretical basis for the ship's use of explosives to fight the sound torpedo. We use the CEEMDAN method to process the simulated underwater explosion signal and the actual underwater explosion signal mixed ship signal. The results show that the CEEMDAN decomposition method is highly adaptable.It can be seen through analysis of the Hilbert spectrum. When the water depth is 200m, the energy of the underwater explosion signal is mainly concentrated within 50.9kHz. When two explosives are detonated at the same time, it is relatively widely distributed between 25.4kHz. The energy above 50.9kHz is relatively small. The actual data is also a strong display of the low frequency part after the signal decomposition.The CEEMDAN-Hilbert method proposed in this article is suitable for analysis of underwater explosion signals.

articleTitle: A Smoking Behavior Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5 and Key Points of Human Skeleton
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As people realize the harm of smoking in public places, the problem of how to improve the detection efficiency of smoking behavior in surveillance video remains to be solved. In recent years, the algorithm of pose estimation based on the key points of human bones has become more and more mature. In this paper, an algorithm for smoking behavior detection based on the relationship between the position information of the key points of human bones and smoking behavior is proposed. The algorithm first uses AlphaPose to detect the key point information of human bones, and determines whether the behavior is smoking by calculating the distance ratio (SBR) between the wrist and the nose and the wrist and the eye on the same side. YOLOv5 was used to detect whether there were cigarette butts in the video. Weight fusion of cigarette probability detected by SBR and YOLOv5 was performed to determine whether there was smoking behavior. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively detect smoking behavior with an accuracy of 93.3%. Finally, the abnormal behavior recognition system in the library environment is developed through Python3.8 and PyQt development languages, and the two algorithms proposed in this paper are integrated into the system to realize the visualization of the two abnormal behavior recognition results, which proves the effectiveness of the abnormal behavior recognition algorithm proposed in this paper, and also shows that the system has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Location Algorithms for Anti Network Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: When hackers carry out network attacks on Beidou satellites, which affect the visible number of satellites and signal transmission, ships cannot perform normal positioning. Therefore, under the premise of network attacks on the Beidou satellite, this article uses a mathematical model of pseudo range positioning to solve the ship's position using an improved least squares algorithm and an improved Kalman filtering algorithm, respectively. The simulation results show that when part of the signal information is lost, the two improved positioning algorithms proposed can effectively locate ships, which has a certain improvement in accuracy compared to traditional positioning algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Laboratory Unsafe Behavior Recognition Based on Robust Time Feature Learning Advancement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of dangerous accidents caused by unsafe behaviors in university laboratories, We propose an improved method based on the RTFM model. This method combines Dilated convolution and multi-head attention mechanism to form a new feature aggregation module and improve the sensitivity to abnormal features. In addition, the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) is introduced to capture the timing information in the video, effectively solving the problem of false detection when RTFM detects anomalies. Experimental results show that compared with the original model, the method in this paper improves AUC by 4%. Effectively improves the accuracy of identifying abnormal behaviors of laboratory personnel.

articleTitle: Dynamic Planning Scheduling Study of Unmanned Mining Trucks in Open-pit Mines
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The open-pit mines extremely easily cause mining trucks to be unable to correctly judge the state of vehicles and environment in front of them in the process of meeting or following the vehicle due to the obstruction of mountains and other terrain features, which affects the safety and efficiency of vehicle driving. Utilizing vehicle-road cooperative technology can effectively solve the problem of insufficient sight distance in curved areas and improve driving safety and efficiency of unmanned mining trucks. This paper proposes a dynamic planning scheduling strategy for unmanned mining trucks at curved intersections based on vehicle-road cooperative technology so that when unmanned mining trucks conflict in special road sections, they can be scheduled through local dynamic planning, thus eliminating conflicts, effectively improving road capacity and guaranteeing the safety of open-pit mine transportation.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Smoothness in a Man-on-wheels Assisted Marching Device
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The man-on-wheels assisted marching device is a mobile device that enhances the rapid marching. capability of a single soldier. The vibration characteristics of the device not only affect the comfort and fatigue of the soldier, but also affect the travelling safety of the device. This paper establishes the man-machine dynamics model and the eight-degree-of-freedom vibration model of the soldier wheeled assisted marching device, and applies MATLAB to design a vibration simulation system to simulate and calculate the vibration characteristics of the soldier wheeled assisted marching device. By calculating its acceleration rms and weighted vibration level, the result of human subjective feeling is obtained, which proves that the device has good smoothness.

articleTitle: Distributed Radar Angle Measurement Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Distributed radar systems are pivotal in modern military and civilian contexts, with phased array radar technology greatly impacting angle measurement precision for target tracking and identification. This article presents a novel angle measurement approach for distributed radar systems, harnessing deep learning. This technique not only heightens angle measurement precision but also optimizes network efficiency, enhancing overall system performance. To validate our method, we conducted extensive experiments involving diverse angle targets, both large and small, consistently achieving outstanding results across scenarios. This underscores the method's exceptional accuracy and robustness in real-world situations. In summary, our innovative distributed radar angle measurement technique, driven by deep learning, promises improved accuracy and efficiency, bolstering the capabilities of distributed radar systems across applications.

articleTitle: Research on Active Disturbance Rejection Control of PMSM Based on Improved BOA
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low control accuracy, poor anti-interference ability and poor robustness due to the interference and parameter changes of the servo system of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) under PI control, an improved active disturbance rejection control strategy is proposed. On the basis of linearisation and bandwidth of the extended state observer, the controller parameters are combined with the bandwidth in the project. Furthermore, to improve the parameter optimization tuning effect, the butterfly optimization algorithm is not high in convergence accuracy, speed and stationarity, and it is easy to avoid falling into the problem of local optimum, the reverse learning strategy, Cauchy variation and sine and cosine guidance mechanism are introduced to optimise the algorithm, and simulation experiments are carried out. The results show that compared with the traditional Proportion Integral(PI) control and active disturbance rejection control, the proposed method can quickly track a given speed, has higher control speed, and can be used to control the local optimum. The results show that compared with the traditional PI control and active disturbance rejection control, the proposed method can quickly track a given speed, has higher control accuracy and anti-interference ability, and effectively ensures the robustness of the PMSM servo system.

articleTitle: IO-Link Safety and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Safety concepts and risk considerations have become increasingly important in engineering due to standards like IO-Link and the dissolution of the OT and IT pyramid, and also due to Industry 4.0. As the underlying communication technology of the IoT, IO-Link uses methods such as synchronous counter, monitoring by "watchdog" and CRC segment to maintain safety in the communication process, at the same time, the key and decryption algorithm are added to ensure security. Through these measures, IO-Link achieves smooth and high-speed operation during the communication process, and also reduces the risk of data abuse due to the bidirectional communication between IO-Link and IT The experiment proves that IO-Link can guarantee its safety and security in the process of data transmission.

articleTitle: A method of EEG emotion recognition based on residual contraction network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The emotional constantly affects human body, mind and behavior. The accurate recognition of emotion has a broad application prospect in the medical field. Although deep learning algorithms have made some achievements in emotion recognition research, there are still some problems such as insufficient extraction of EEG (Electroencephalogram) frequency features, spatial features and time features, noise interference and complex model parameters. In this thesis, the 4D-RSC-BiLSTM (Four-Dimensional Residual Shrinkage Convolutional Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory Neural Network) is constructed, and the convolutional layer is inserted into the deep separable convolutional network to complete the improvement of network structure and parameter adjustment. Then the residual shrinkage module is combined with the improved deep separable convolutional network to remove redundant features and reduce the network computing cost while solving the problem of model gradient disappearance. The experimental results show that the proposed model is feasible in emotion recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Signal Recognition under Underwater Explosion Interference Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Noise sources have always been a huge obstacle to the development of underwater target recognition. Based on this, this article obtains underwater target signals and explosion signals through simulation, and couples the target ship signal with the explosion signal to obtain the target ship signal containing strong noise interference. The time-frequency analysis of explosion, target, and their mixed signals is carried out through wavelet transform. The time-frequency characteristics are used to identify target signals under explosion interference. The research results have certain reference significance for underwater target recognition research.

articleTitle: Lightweight Image Deraining Network Based on Dilated Depthwise Separable Convolution and Enhanced Channel Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Rainy conditions can introduce significant challenges for various computer vision tasks such as detection and recognition. Addressing the limitations of existing image deraining models in terms of model complexity and performance, this paper proposes a lightweight and efficient deraining network. Firstly, it proposes a multi-scale image feature extraction method based on a shifting window and a fusion method for image features, enhancing the representation of rain streaks. Then, it constructs a separable feature channel attention mechanism to extract rain streak features meticulously, accurately, and efficiently. Finally, it designs a collaborative expansion, depth separable, and globally enhanced detail restoration network to compensate for the loss of some rain streak details that the network may experience. Compared with the traditional image training network, the network significantly reduces the number of parameters, thereby greatly shortening the training time. In addition, the network also showed excellent performance in rainy conditions. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs well on public datasets such as Rain200L, Rain200H and Rain800, and can effectively remove rain artifacts from images.

articleTitle: Low Energy Scheduling of Hybrid Mine Trucks with Application of Wireless Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of energy consumption in open pit mine truck transport, this paper takes hybrid mine trucks as the research object and realizes the wireless charging of hybrid mine trucks by setting up wireless power transfer charging piles. To minimize transport cost and energy consumption, the transport road conditions and production tasks between each loading point and unloading point are considered comprehensively, and the characteristics of energy recovery of hybrid mine trucks are taken into account in the design of the scheduling algorithm so that the low-energy scheduling model of hybrid mine trucks is established and solved. The final results show that the study can effectively reduce the transport cost and energy consumption and the operating cost of mining enterprises.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Re-recognition Method Based on Pose Estimation and Regional Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the local feature misalignment caused by the complexity of the pedestrian re-recognition scene and the difficulty of extracting the pedestrian features with invariance under the background clutter, we present a pedestrian re-recognition method based on the human body's gesture estimation and regional feature fusion. The pose estimation algorithm is introduced into the network to build aligned pedestrian features; The low-level global features are fused. Fine-grained pose features are constructed and aligned through two-branch structure in order that the model focuses more on key information about the target and the structural information of the human body. The correlation of global and local features is abstracted. The results of experiment on two mainstream datasets, Market-1501 and DukeMTMC-ReID, indicate that our method exceeds the level of the original baseline PCB algorithm. Compared with the baseline algorithm, the first hit accuracy Rank-1 is improved by 7.6% in the DukeMTMC-ReID dataset. The mean average precision mAP is improved by 12.8%.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Path Planning Based on Improved Smooth A* Algorithm and Optimized Dynamic Window Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the issues of low search efficiency, redundant nodes, and poor smoothness associated with the traditional A* algorithm in robotic path planning, this paper proposes a robot path planning algorithm that integrates an improved smooth A* algorithm with the Dynamic Window Approach (DWA). A dynamic weight factor is introduced into the cost function of the A* algorithm's heuristic function to enhance path search efficiency. The global path is optimized for redundancy using the Floyd algorithm, reducing the number of turns. The optimized global path is then further processed for path circular arc smoothing, effectively eliminating rough turns and improving the overall smoothness of the path. The evaluation function of the DWA algorithm is optimized, combining the improved A* algorithm with the Dynamic Window Approach. The global path's key nodes serve as target points for the DWA algorithm, enabling segmented path planning. Simulation results demonstrate that the improved A* algorithm effectively overcomes the deficiencies of the traditional A* algorithm, and robots using the integrated algorithm can closely adhere to the globally optimal path, exhibiting improved obstacle avoidance performance in the presence of unknown obstacles.

articleTitle: Multimodal Emotion Recognition based on Convolutional Neural Networks and Long Short-Term Memory Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Due to the rapid advancements in big data and high-performance computing technologies, the application of deep learning models in the fields of computer vision and signal image processing has become increasingly widespread. To address the low efficiency and accuracy in the recognition of multimodal emotional EEG signals, this study integrates the latest deep learning network models, leveraging the advantages of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in EEG feature extraction and the strengths of long short-term memory (LSTM) networks in processing dynamic temporal information. Therefore, this study employs CNN models to extract features from multimodal EEG signals, followed by feature vector fusion using LSTM, and classification using softmax. The network model constructed in this study achieved an accuracy of 92% in the three-class emotion recognition. Compared with traditional classification methods, the CNN-LSTM network model exhibits higher recognition efficiency due to its combined advantages in feature extraction and dynamic temporal information processing. Compared to using CNN or LSTM models alone, this model also shows a significant improvement in recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: A Study on Student Behavior Recognition Based on YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Student classroom behavior is an important part of classroom instructional research, and student behavior reflects their level of attention and participation in teaching content, providing valuable feedback to educators. Based on the research on student classroom behavior recognition based on deep learning, this paper combines the complex environment of university classrooms to accurately identify student behaviors. The research and innovation of this paper are as follows: (1) Establish a dataset. Taking the behavior data of students in a school classroom as the research object, three behaviors of "learning", "sleeping" and "playing with mobile phones" were studied.(2) The lightweight MobileOne is used to replace the YOLOv7 backbone feature extraction network, which reduces the number of parameters and greatly shortens the detection time. (3) BiFPN is used at the neck of the network to enhance the feature representation ability through adaptive feature fusion and context-aware mechanism, so as to improve the learning ability of the model. The network model proposed in this paper analyzes the experimental results on this self-defined data set, and the average detection accuracy reaches 88.67%, which is improved by 8% ; the parameters of the model are only 32.58 MB, which is decreased by 42.51%; the detection speed is 64.33 f/s, and the network parameters are reduced by 42.51%, increased by about 5.37 f/s. It has faster recognition speed and accuracy, and is more suitable for class student behavior classification detection.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Deep-water Explosion Damage of Ring-ribbed Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Based on AUTODYN software for deep water explosion ring rib cylinder structure numerical calculations, comparative analysis of the impact of different model building methods on the response of the cylinder structure, and ultimately determine the method of model building, analysed the deformation of the cylinder under different hydrostatic pressure, and investigated the response of the cylinder after the explosion loads under different water depths. The results of the study show that: in the analysis of the response of the cylinder in the deep-water explosion can be achieved through the load boundary conditions on the structure loaded with prestressing; when the shock wave load is kept constant, with the increase of the hydrostatic pressure in the environment, the damage at the centre of the ring-ribbed cylinder shell facing the explosion surface increases.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Implementation Based on Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Image processing is a technique that involves the manipulation and enhancement of digital images. It encompasses various aspects such as image acquisition, image preprocessing, image enhancement, image segmentation, feature extraction, and object detection. The purpose of image processing is to process and enhance images using computer technology, aiming to achieve higher image quality for subsequent processing and applications. In practical applications, image processing techniques employ different algorithms and methods to achieve various processing and enhancement effects. Additionally, image processing techniques can be applied in fields such as medicine, security, autonomous driving, VR/AR, etc. For instance, in the medical field, image processing techniques can be utilized for image segmentation and diagnosis of medical images, thereby improving the accuracy and analytical capabilities of medical imaging. In the security field, image processing techniques can be employed for tasks such as video surveillance and facial recognition, enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of security monitoring. In the domain of autonomous driving, image processing techniques can be used for detecting and recognizing the surrounding environment of vehicles, thereby enhancing the safety and performance of autonomous driving systems. In conclusion, image processing technology is a very important technology. By continuously improving the accuracy and reliability of the algorithm, it is expected to be applied in a wider range of applications.

articleTitle: A Composite Chaotic Sequence Generation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of weak attack resistance, insufficient complexity, monotonous generation, and narrow key space in generating chaotic sequences for low-dimensional chaotic mappings, we propose a novel composite chaotic sequence generation method, which combines Improved Logistic chaotic sequences, Chebyshev chaotic sequences and M-sequences. Through simulation studies, we evaluate the key properties of this composite chaotic sequence such as initial value sensitivity, complexity, balance and correlation. The results show that the sequence excels in initial value sensitivity and correlation, while exhibiting better balance and higher complexity.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Device Path Planning Based on Improved A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Path planning for mobile devices is currently a hot research topic. To address the issue of excessive path turning points in the A* algorithm, we expand the search neighborhood. To improve the low search efficiency of the traditional A* algorithm, we enhance the cost function. Through experimental simulations and data comparisons, it is concluded that compared to the traditional A* algorithm, the optimized and improved A* algorithm results in fewer path turning points, shorter path lengths, and higher planning efficiency. The optimized and improved A* algorithm outperforms the traditional A* algorithm in terms of path planning time, path nodes, and turning points.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Based on Cross Task Information Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This article selects StarCraft as the experimental environment, which has a complex and vast action and state space, making it difficult for intelligent agents to make optimal decisions. In this article, the sharing of parameter experience values among multiple agents in a single task is used to enhance the collaboration ability between agents and avoid repetitive learning of basic strategies. In addition, after distilling and refining the core strategies of individual tasks, policy interaction is carried out in multiple tasks of the same type. By establishing a joint objective function for multiple tasks and alternating optimization for mutual constraints and updating iterations, information exchange between cross task multi-agent systems is completed, solving the problem of difficulty in obtaining effective data in complex scenarios and improving the learning efficiency of micro unit joint decision-making. This paper also adds qualification tracking to solve the problem of reward delay at the initial stage of model training, and uses course transfer learning to complete incremental joint training.

articleTitle: Dynamic Simulation of Adsorbed Lane-corner Watch Sniper Launcher
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of intelligent weapon coordination in urban confined space of individual squad, the structure design and simulation of the adsorptive lane-corner watch sniper launcher are carried out. We design of launcher structure based on 9mm caliber submachine gun. Through calculation, design parameters and existing product dimensions, the dimensions of the required components are obtained, and the model of the launcher components is established. Based on UG motion simulation module, the dynamic characteristics of the launcher running for 60s at different spatial positions of ground, wall and wall top were studied. By analyzing the stress-strain diagram and motion curve obtained, it can be seen that the adsorbed lane-corner sniper launcher is stable in structure and reliable in operation, and its quality, direction and high and low firing angle can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Shenyang Event Venue Reservation System Based on Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As all walks of life gradually return to normal, various event venues in Shenyang are both full and idle. In order to make full and effective use of venue resources, event venue booking is particularly important. This paper designs a Shenyang event venue reservation system based on intelligent computing. The design process mainly includes the user front-end interface design. The system is developed using Eclipse tools, using three major frameworks: Intelligent Computing, Spring MVC and MyBatis. MySQL is used in the background for data management, and Java Web is used for coding. This system uses user learning to push personalized venue reservation plans, saving users time in selecting and arranging venues, and has practical significance. The methods used in the design process and the conclusions drawn have certain guiding significance for the practical application of the intelligent computing framework.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Access Control System Based on Raspberry PI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Automatic access control system based on Raspberry Pi and Arduino UNO development board uses the CSI camera of Raspberry Pi to capture the face information, compare it with the face database, judge whether it meets the data in the database, and then send the signal to the Arduino UNO development board through the Bluetooth module to control the servo to simulate the opening and closing of the door. The system modules are clearly divided, the program is readable, the hardware and software are easy to modify, and it has considerable accuracy.

articleTitle: Early Image Recognition of Forest Fire Based on Improved YOLOv5 Neck Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Forest fires can lead to environmental degradation and loss of biodiversity. In order to detect forest fires more efficiently in the early stage, an improved YOLOv5 algorithm is proposed in this paper. Adding a small target detection layer to YOLOv5 neck network to enhance the Identification ability of small target images at the onset of forest fire, because the increase of channel length of feature fusion network after adding a small target layer will lead to information loss, therefore, BIFPN feature fusion network is fused. Experimental results indicate that improved YOLOv5 outperforms the original YOLOv5 in small target recognition of fire image, especially when the flame is occluded.

articleTitle: Inception-ResNet Assisted Iterative Decoding Algorithm Based on Alternating Direction Multiplier Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The application of deep learning to channel decoding methods has gradually become a hot research topic. However, the high complexity of deep neural network (DNN) parameters hinders the application of deep neural networks to long codes, and the difficulty of decoding increases exponentially with the increase of code length. To address this problem, this paper proposes a low-density parity-check (LDPC) decoding based on alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) assisted by Inception-RestNet network. After passing through the channel with the noise codeword through the Inception-RestNet network to achieve the denoising process is input to the traditional ADMM decoder, and then according to the traditional this algorithm calculates the codeword with the original with the noise codeword to be processed and then go to reverse optimization of the denoising network, iterative operation between the Inception-RestNet and the hard verdict decoder can be reduce the effect of noise on the coded modulation system, thus enabling the decoder to obtain more accurate estimates. Experimental results show that the BER performance of this IR-ADMM decoder is improved by 0.5 dB with fewer iterations than the conventional LDPC decoder.

articleTitle: Research on the Detection Method of Safety Helmet by Introducing Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In this paper, YOLOv5 is optimized to maintain high performance in helmet detection. This algorithm incorporates the coordinate attention mechanism to enhance the attention of the network to the identification of small objects such as hard hats. The sensitivity of IoU to small deviation of target position is solved by using normalized Wasserstein distance loss function. Furthermore, the original data is expanded to improve its generalization capability and compel the model to acquire more robust features. The proposed method is specifically applied to helmet-wearing detection scenarios. Test results demonstrate that compared with traditional YOLOv5, the improved algorithm exhibits an increase of 4.1 percentage points in accuracy and 3 percentage points in mAP values for helmet detection. Additionally, there is also a noticeable improvement in recall rate, indicating its effectiveness in detecting helmets across various scenes and scales.

articleTitle: Research on SSVEP Recognition Method Based on Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Currently, Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) is a research hotspot, playing a crucial role in various fields. The difficulty of research is to identify the obtained Electroencephalography (EEG) signals. There are now a large number of recognition methods, but they all have certain shortcomings. Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA), which is highly sensitive to noise and has poor performance for frequency or phase dense stimuli. Some researchers also use machine learning for signal recognition, but it requires relatively complex feature extraction. Research results indicate that its accuracy is relatively low. In order to tackle the aforementioned challenges such as low recognition accuracy and complex feature extraction, the paper proposes a deep learning-based method for recognizing steady-state visually evoked potentials (SSVEPs). The neural network employs a residual network (ResNet)for implementation. This method utilizes residual networks to extract features from signal data and complete model training through fully connected operations. Input samples into the model to achieve adaptive feature extraction and end-to-end classification of EEG signals. The recognition method proposed in this article can fully extract signal features, achieve effective recognition of SSVEP signals under short-term visual stimuli, and have high target recognition efficiency. The experimental results indicate that compared to the aforementioned recognition methods, the method proposed in this paper exhibits improvements in both recognition accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis and protection strategy based on Modular Multilevel Converter Direct Current faults
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper conducts in-depth research on the topology structure, working principle, and modulation methods of Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC), providing theoretical support to examine the fault traits on the Direct Current (DC) side. The paper focuses on analyzing the typical DC side faults within the modular multilevel converter-based high-voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) system and validates the analysis results of DC side faults through simulation using the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. It also proposes a Full-Bridge Modular Multilevel Converter (FBMMC) topology structure that effectively controls the energy exchange during the DC side fault by introducing a submodule capacitor in the bridge arm.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Wireless Sensor Network Detection Software
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper investigates the technology of sensor network node parameter monitoring software and designs a complete monitoring software solution in conjunction with a specific application scenario of greenhouse monitoring. The communication data verification algorithm is thoroughly studied in this study, and the discussion and research on the nonlinear calibration algorithm of sensor parameters in data processing are conducted. The CRC cyclic redundancy algorithm and the least squares method are employed in the subsequent software design for relevant data processing.The real-time monitoring system is based on sensor network technology, integrating measurement and control to achieve remote monitoring. The system formats the data and uploads it to the host computer via COM serial communication according to the set transmission mode and communication protocol. Upon receiving a series of data packets, the system analyzes the data, dynamically displays it in real-time, issues normal or alarm messages, and notifies the system through different means. The software of this system demonstrates good operational performance, meeting the basic requirements of the application scenario. It possesses excellent monitoring real-time capability, openness, and compatibility, providing comprehensive information and decision support for sensor network node parameter monitoring.

articleTitle: A Computation Offloading Method for Delay Optimization in F-RAN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the problem of delay optimization, a computation offloading scheme is proposed within a NOMA-based Fog Radio Access Network (F-RAN) system. This scheme involves selecting the offloading method with the lowest delay for user tasks, which may involve offloading tasks to a Fog Access Point (F-AP) for computation or forwarding tasks via the F-AP or Remote Radio Head (RRH) to the cloud for processing. Through the reasonable allocation of computational resources, multiple F-APs can share the same Resource Block (RB), thereby enhancing transmission efficiency and reducing computation offloading delay.

articleTitle: Research on Kinect Segmentation Algorithm Based on Pig Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Since arrival of new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics, living standards and quality of life of people have gradually improved. Farmers hope to obtain physical signs of livestock without causing stress reactions, and this demand is gradually increasing. Moreover, animal protection personnel hope to gradually increase requirement for measuring physical characteristics of animals without disturbing them. Therefore, method proposed in this article enables breeders and animal protection personnel to achieve hope of non-contact measurement to obtain animal signs. Contactless measurement has always been one of main research directions in machine vision, using point cloud segmentation method to filter out background point cloud ground and railing of pigs under complex conditions. Point cloud segmentation is a prerequisite for all basic applications, not only for point cloud reconstruction but also for segmentation and classification applications. In point cloud segmentation, a random sampling consensus algorithm (RANSAC) combined with conditional Euclidean clustering segmentation algorithm is proposed. Using single choice point cloud segmentation to divide entire point cloud into two parts, effectively obtaining target point cloud information.

articleTitle: Research on SLAM Dynamic Target Removal Method Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Integrating object detection into the ORB-SLAM2 system, using object detection algorithms to annotate objects with motion attributes in the environment, and then relying solely on the keyframes of static objects for map construction, can effectively remove the impact of dynamic objects on semantic map construction. This article uses YOLO4 for dynamic object detection in SLAM system, and uses this object detection algorithm to remove dynamic objects from environment. Simulation experiment shows that 3D semantic map effect of dynamic object removal is good. It is of great significance to increase perception ability of mobile robots to environment.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Blast Damage in Masonry Walls
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to study the damage effect of charge explosion on masonry wall, ANSYS/LS-DYNA software was used to simulate the effect of different doses on masonry wall at different burst distances, and the kinetic response process of masonry wall under two dosages of 500kg and 1000kg and different explosion distances was obtained, and the damage mode of masonry wall with different dosages at different explosion distances was analyzed. The results show that with the continuous weakening of the explosion load, the damage mode of the wall is the middle hole, the upper collapse, the middle deformation, the front tipping, the whole collapse, the whole collapse forward, and the partial dumping forward. Taking the middle separation distance and maximum step height of the masonry wall as the standard, when the dosage of 500kg is obtained, the minimum critical damage explosion distance of the wall is 2.5m, the maximum critical damage explosion distance is 3.5m, and the critical damage explosion distance of the wall is 7m when the dose of 1000kg is obtained.

articleTitle: An Information Completion Method Based on Security Knowledge Graph with Fusing Neighborhood Information
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In the research of knowledge graph completion, the issue of missing information in open-source network security knowledge repositories has persisted due to challenges such as difficulty in coordinating heterogeneous information and maintaining historical data. To address the problem of insufficient feature learning from different domains in existing information completion methods, a information completion method based on security knowledge graph with fusing neighborhood information (KGC-N), is proposed. To capture neighborhood information, this method constructs a security knowledge graph associated with the Structured Threat Information Expression (STIX 2.1) open-source network security knowledge repository. During the data preprocessing phase, Global Vectors for Word Representation (GloVe) is used to enhance the model's training effectiveness. Leveraging graph traversal techniques, it captures neighborhood information with various relationships within a multi-hop range through the knowledge graph. The captured neighborhood features are then learned using a Graph Attention Network to enhance the model's predictive performance. Experimental results indicate that KGC-N achieves a Mean Ranking of 196 and a Mean Reciprocal Ranking of 0.6127, outperforming baseline methods.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of Turbulence Model in High Mach Solid Ramjet Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Propose a novel internal flow field structure for high Mach solid ramjet engines and perform structural mesh division. In the computational fluid dynamics(CFD) numerical simulation of gas-solid two-phase combustion using Fluent, the gas-phase control equation adopts the Reynolds averaged conservation Navier Stokes (N-S) equation for multi-component chemical reactions in the Cartesian coordinate system. Using the control variable method, two sets of examples were set up. The impact of the convection-diffusion term and turbulence model on the calculation results was obtained by comparing the temperature cloud map of the internal flow field, combustion chamber outlet temperature, and thrust of the two sets of examples. Then, the differences between the calculation results of different convection-diffusion terms and turbulence models were analyzed, and the convection-diffusion term and turbulence model suitable for the actual situation were selected.

articleTitle: Research on Fruit Picking Positioning Based on Binocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Based on YOLOv5 object detection algorithm, fruit images are extracted from complex backgrounds in response to occlusion of branches and leaves, fruit overlap, and light effects caused by environment. Method of adding center coordinate value of image based on prediction box of fruit image determines centroid coordinate of target image. Then, by optimizing the focus camera and using Zhang Youzheng's calibration method, the image is calibrated using Matlab calibration box. Obtained image is stereo corrected using local stereo matching algorithm to obtain three-dimensional coordinates of centroid of target fruit, which are then converted into physical coordinates for positioning, After actual measurement, a positioning result with an error of ± 20mm was obtained, confirming its applicability for practical positioning operations.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Based Method for Peak-to-Average Power Ratio Reduction in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) technology, renowned for its multicarrier transmission paradigm, encounters a formidable challenge characterized by an elevated Peak-to-Average Power Ratio (PAPR). This phenomenon can precipitate an escalation in signal distortion. In this study, we present an innovative approach wherein a neural network is harnessed to enhance the attenuation of PAPR, synthesizing the techniques of peak clipping and dilated convolution. Simultaneously, a recovery module is integrated to optimize the signal quality post-suppression, especially at the receiver's terminal. Our empirical findings manifest a noteworthy upswing in the efficacy of PAPR suppression, underscoring the remarkable performance augmentation realized through the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Adaptive Spectral Clustering HRM-ISC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As a crucial component in the realm of data mining, In the past few years, the focus of researchers in the field of data mining has significantly shifted towards the exploration of clustering analysis, garnering widespread interest and recognition, and a considerable multitude of theories and methods have been produced. Based on the conventional clustering algorithm, spectral clustering converts the partition of the data set into the partition of the graph, and can identify the clusters composed of arbitrary shape sample data. The traditional spectral clustering algorithm NJW has problems such as difficult parameter selection in the clustering process and poor clustering effect on non-convex or non-uniform density data sets. In this paper, a hot region mining algorithm built upon improved spectral clustering (HRM-ISC) is suggested. In the first place, The enhancement of the local scale parameter in the self-tuning algorithm is achieved by incorporating the standard deviation of the sample neighborhood, which avoids the interference of the local scale parameter of the sample by noise points and the parameter selection depends on the empirical value to the maximum extent, so that the similarity matrix of the sample reflects the distribution information of the sample more accurately. Secondly, The conventional spectral clustering approach can not automatically estimate the optimal number of clusters and the eigenvector selection is difficult. According to the matrix perturbation theory, an adaptive spectral clustering algorithm utilizing eigengap is used to solve the problem. Finally, to tackle challenge of sensitivity to the initial clustering center encountered in the K-Means algorithm, the K-Medoids algorithm with variance maximization of initial clustering center was employed as a substitute.

articleTitle: Channel Analysis and Performance Enhancement for VLC under Smoke Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Visible light communication (VLC) is widely used in communication systems due to its high transmission rate and strong resistance to electromagnetic interference characteristics. However, smoke in the environment can affect the visible light channel, which reduces transmission distance and even results in communication failure. Therefore, we propose a VLC system to analyze the communication performance under smoke conditions and improve communication distance. First, we establish a reasonable channel model that accords with the actual conditions of smoke based on the Mie scattering theory and the Monte Carlo method. We simulate visible light transmission in smoke conditions and enhance the theoretical analysis upper limit of visible light communication performance according to the channel model. Furthermore, we propose an enhanced modulation method based on pulse position modulation (E-PPM), effectively reducing the bit error rate of communication data and improving the transmission distance by increasing the duration of high levels. Finally, the established channel model can accurately reflect the transmission performance of white LED in smoke conditions, and the proposed modulation method can effectively reduce the system's bit error rate and increase the transmission distance by 0-0.5m.

articleTitle: Modulation Mode Recognition Method with Multi-feature Fusion under a Complex Noise Floor
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Increasing the accuracy of modulation signal recognition in a generalized noise environment is an important problem nowadays. To address this problem, a deep neural network-based modulation mode recognition method FF-net (Feature Fusion net) is proposed in a generalized noise environment. The method firstly extracts and fuses the constellation map features and time domain features of the signal, which increases the diversity of feature extraction; then the Res2Net module and SENet module are used to realize the extraction of channel attention and spatial multi-scale features, which improves the validity and versatility of the feature extraction, and thus improves the recognition accuracy of the modulation mode recognition system in different noise environments. The experimental results show that its average recognition rate reaches 99.5% under the condition of α=0 signal-to-noise ratio of 0~10dB, and 86.1% under the condition of α=2 signal-to-noise ratio of 0~10dB, which is better than other existing algorithms under the same conditions.

articleTitle: A study on active power balance control of wind/photovoltaic storage system based on multiple rotating vector superposition approach
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the massive increase in the energy share of renewable energy sources and the development of energy storage systems, the generation control of integrated energy systems is facing serious challenges. On the one hand, renewable energy generation is characterized by volatility and uncertainty. Large-scale grid integration of renewable energy sources decreases the inertia of integrated energy systems. On the other hand, the regulation rate of the energy storage unit is different from that of the frequency regulation unit. Conventional automatic generation control does not consider the differences in the regulation rate of each frequency regulation unit. In this study, a method based on multiple rotating vector superposition (MRVS) is proposed for the active power balance control problem of wind/photovoltaic storage systems. This study proposes a vector control method containing two independent algorithms for wind/photovoltaic and energy storage systems, respectively. To make the frequency control of wind/photovoltaic storage systems more stable, in this study, all three energy modes are subjected to rotary vector control and then superimposed to form a frequency-integrated coordinated control method. This study compares the proposed MRVS with seven other well-established algorithms. Q(λ) works best among the contrasting methods, however, the area control error, frequency deviation, and economy indexes of the proposed MRVS are 7.12%, 5.08%, and 1208.2 $ smaller than Q(λ), respectively, verifying the feasibility of the MRVS.

articleTitle: RBF Neural Network Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Realizes Self-similar Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that network traffic prediction can effectively improve network congestion control, A traffic prediction model based on Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural networks optimized by Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) has been proposed for predicting self-similar network traffic. After a large number of studies, it is shown that high-performance and high-efficiency network traffic has self-similarity characteristics, and according to this characteristic, the self-similar traffic can be predicted. In order to achieve high-precision network traffic prediction, firstly, the datasets are input into the RBF neural network, and then the parameters of the RBF neural network are optimized using the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm to reduce the prediction error of traffic. Finally, experimental results show that the PSO-RBF neural network prediction model has high prediction accuracy and better adaptability compared to the BP neural network optimized by genetic algorithms, enabling efficient and accurate traffic prediction to meet the demand for improved network performance.

articleTitle: Research on Cleaning Method of Wind Power Data Based on Improved Quartile Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: A method is proposed to address the challenge of anomalous wind speed and power data in wind farms, aiming to clean the wind power data. This method utilizes an enhanced quartile approach and involves two main steps. Initially, the Bin zoning method is employed to preprocess the extensive data by leveraging the actual operational data from wind turbines in Jilin Wind Farm. Subsequently, the enhanced quartile method is implemented to cleanse the wind power data post zoning. In this step, the improved quartile method cleans the scattered data, and the MeanShift algorithm is employed to clean the folded data. Finally, the proposed algorithm is compared with the data purified by the quartile method and the MeanShift method, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Malicious Traffic Detection Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: For network traffic, how to distinguish malicious traffic from normal traffic is very important. To this end, we introduce deep learning as a powerful tool for malicious traffic detection, and its excellent learning ability shines in this field. This paper proposes a double-layer neural network model based on deep learning, which combines DCNN and LSTM networks to detect and classify network traffic. The UNSW_NB15 dataset was used, LabelEncoder function and MAX-MIN standardization were used to preprocess the data, ADASYN was used to balance the data, random forest algorithm and Pearson correlation analysis were used to select the features, and 27 features were finally selected for classification. DCNN extracts features, LSTM builds a sequence model to deal with long-term dependencies, and finally, softmax classifier is used. Compared with the single DCNN and LSTM structure, the double-layer neural network model shows a good classification effect.

articleTitle: Index Modulation Technique Based on Variable Sub-carrier Number
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: OFDM-IM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Index Modulation) can improve the bandwidth utilization of the system by adding additional index information. However, with the increase of modulation order, the bandwidth utilization of OFDM-IM decreases compared to the traditional OFDM system. To solve this problem, we propose an index modulation method with a variable sub-carrier number based on OFDM-SNM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Sub-Carrier Number Modulation). In this method, the first sub-carrier in each sub-block is fixed to transmit information, and the remaining sub-carriers are fully permuted among the available sub-carriers according to different numbers. This method can significantly increase the transmission bits of additional index information and further improve bandwidth utilization. Our analysis shows that the bandwidth utilization of this new method increases compared with OFDM-IM and OFDM-SNM. Simulation results show that the new method also has good bit error rate (BER) performances under different modulation orders and sub-block sizes.

articleTitle: Optimal Chaos Sequence Prediction Based on Optimized Radial Basis Function Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to better predict chaotic time series, this paper proposes a normalized detrended spatiotemporal radial basis function network (ND-ST-RBFNN) based on the traditional radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) and the spatiotemporal radial basis function network (ST-RBFNN). The input data is normalized and detrended using a linear regression model before entering the network. This method is used to predict the Chebyshev chaotic time series. Compared to the traditional ST-RBFNN, this method reduces the mean squared error of the predictions and improves prediction accuracy. Experimental results illustrate the efficacy of this approach, showing good performance and flexibility in chaotic time series prediction problems.

articleTitle: Application and Practice of PaddleOCR Based Image Recognition Technology in Business License
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In view of the food and beverage business related qualification supervision is more difficult, more manual participation leads to error prone problems, this paper realizes a food and beverage business license recognition method based on OCR recognition technology. This method can extract key fields such as unified social credit code and company name. It can assist to solve the management problems of related catering business. Compared with traditional manual management, this method saves manpower and material resources to a certain extent. This method makes the management process more convenient and simple, provides ideas for the automation and intelligence of business license information management method, and plays an important role in promoting the development and promotion of business license information management.

articleTitle: Occluded Face Recognition Method Based on Multi-Scale Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In previous occluded face recognition models, the performance of partially occluded face recognition is significantly degraded due to the problems of limited recognizable features and high model complexity. In this article, We presented an occlusion method for faces based on a multi-scale attention mechanism by replacing the 3×3 convolution in the bottleneck block with a PSA attention module. The method cleans up the features damaged by masking by generating masks to conceal them, and then utilizes the multi-scale attention mechanism to effectively extract spatial information. Experiments show that the method is better than previous methods and effectively improves the accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Vertical Search Engine Technology for National Defense Education Curriculum Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Nowadays, the importance of national the importance defenses education courses is increasingly prominent, and using ordinary search engines for searching can no longer meet user needs. This article proposes a vertical search engine in the field of national defense education based on Elasticsearch. This article first introduces the research status of vertical search engines at home and abroad, then elaborates on the framework hierarchy of vertical search engines. Then, it introduces the crawling framework and crawling steps of the web crawler module, the workflow of the index module, and then introduces the Chinese word segmentation technology and sorting algorithm required by vertical search engines. Finally, data analysis is conducted.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Camera Calibration Parameters Based on Multiconditional Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Camera calibration is an important step based on binocular stereo vision technology, and the accuracy of calibration directly affects the accuracy of this visual measurement. In view of the problems of camera calibration, a camera parameter optimisation method based on multiple constraints is proposed. The internal and external parameter values of the camera are calculated as the initial values using Zhang Zhengyou camera calibration method, the parameter optimisation objective function is established through multiple constraints, and the LM algorithm is used to find the optimal parameters. The findings of the experiments indicate a significant enhancement in the precision of camera calibration achieved by the enhanced algorithm, as compared to the traditional approach of the Zhang Zhengyou calibration method..

articleTitle: Network Security State Evaluation Based on BP Network Improved Fuzzy Evaluation Membership Function
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The article presents a method for evaluating network security state using an improved fuzzy evaluation membership function and BP neural networks. The method involves constructing a BP neural network model based on network security behavior data and introducing an enhanced fuzzy evaluation membership function that more accurately describes the relationship between network behavior features and security states. Through training and adjusting the model, the method enables accurate evaluation and prediction of network security states, effectively identifying and predicting security threats in networks. Experimental results demonstrate that the method has high accuracy and reliability, making it potentially valuable in the field of network security.

articleTitle: Encouraging Environmentally-Friendly Power and Transportation Network Operations through a Carbon Subsidy System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To mitigate carbon emissions in the transportation sector, a shift away from gasoline vehicles (GVs) towards new-energy vehicles like electric vehicles (EVs) and hydrogen fuel cell vehicles (HFCVs) is required. However, current research often overlooks the transitional period when GVs, EVs, and HFCVs coexist in significant numbers. This study tackles these challenges by creating a multi-objective optimization model that considers both economic and carbon emission factors. This model aims to harmonize the interrelated activities of power distribution networks and urban transportation networks. Furthermore, an incentive system is introduced through a carbon subsidy mechanism, which provides financial incentives to EV and HFCV users based on their contributions to reducing carbon emissions. The effectiveness of this proposed carbon subsidy mechanism is verified through numerical simulations conducted on an integrated system comprising an IEEE 33-bus electric power grid and a 13-node Nguyen-Dupuis transportation network. These simulations demonstrate the mechanism’s ability to reduce operational costs, decrease carbon emissions in both networks, and motivate drivers to engage in low-carbon demand responses.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection Technology Based on SSD
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As a single-stage object detection model, SSD(Single Shot MultiBox Detector) has been widely used for its advantages such as fast speed and good scalability.
