However, after multi-layer feature extraction, the deep network contains less small target information, resulting in the absence of model detection. When training deep networks, it is easy to have the problem of gradient disappearing and gradient explosion. Therefore, this article will use the ResNet(Residual Network) network instead of the VGG-16(Visual Geometry Group) network in the model to solve these problems. At the same time, through the method of feature fusion, the shallow features and deep features are fused, which enriches the information of different levels and improves the detection accuracy of the model. The experimental results show that the accuracy is improved by 2.2% after replacing VGG with ResNet network, and the accuracy of the model after feature fusion is improved by 4.95% compared with ResNet network.

articleTitle: Multi-layer Graph Convolution Neural Network for Human Behavior Recognition Incorporating Spatial Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the low accuracy in recognizing human behavior in complex environments using existing graph convolution related algorithms , this paper proposed a human body behavior recognition algorithm based on improved graph convolution network. The algorithm alternately used GCN and TCN to extract human features by stacking multi-layer spatiotemporal graph convolutions, and utilized spatiotemporal attention mechanism to enhance spatiotemporal feature extraction. This algorithm used OpenPose to extract human joint information, passed it into an improved spatiotemporal convolutional network model, and finally classified and recognized actions through Softmax. The algorithm was validated on the NTU-RGB+D dataset.Experimental results show that the algorithm can be effective in human behavior recognition ,with recognition accuracy of 88.9%.

articleTitle: Improved Path Planning Algorithm Based on RRT
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Rapidly expanding random tree is a path planning algorithm based on tree structure. It constructs a tree structure of exploration space through random sampling and node expansion, so as to find a feasible path connecting the starting point and the end point. In practical application, RRT algorithm often has the problem of large time overhead. When performing operations such as random sampling, neighbor search, and tree growth, the RRT algorithm requires a lot of calculation and search. Based on the traditional RRT algorithm, an improved algorithm is proposed. Heuristic sampling is introduced to replace the original random sampling strategy. Compared with the traditional RRT algorithm sampling times and calculation time are reduced, and the efficiency and performance of the algorithm are improved.

articleTitle: Design of Network Security Intrusion Detection System Based on NIDSeqFormer Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In the constantly evolving field of network security, the effectiveness of Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) is crucial. This study proposes a network security intrusion detection system based on the NIDSeqFormer framework, which is a modular machine learning pipeline designed to handle sequence to sequence models, in response to the traditional Transformer model's neglect of the serial nature of network communication in identifying the long-term behavior and characteristics of rich networks.It consists of four main components: Pre Processing,Input Encoding, Model, and Classification Head, making it suitable not only for standard tasks but also for handling more complex sequence analysis tasks.To highlight the usefulness and efficiency of the NIDSeqFormer framework, we conducted detailed studies on three frequently used public datasets. We report the accuracy, speed, and model size findings. It was found in the experiment that the selection of input encoding and classification heads has a significant impact on the performance of themodel. After system testing experiments, the results showed that by selecting specific input codes and classification heads, the accuracy of the model can reach over 97%,and the inference and training time can be improved without any loss of accuracy.

articleTitle: Improved Medical Image Segmentation Method and Three-Dimensional Reconstruction Based on 3D-Unet
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In the realm of medicine, the incorporation of deep learning methods for visualizing lesion regions in medical images holds the potential to alleviate the diagnostic burden on clinical practitioners. Within this context, medical image segmentation, as a pivotal component of three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction, assumes pronounced significance due to its capacity for accurately delineating lesion areas. This paper introduces an enhanced medical image segmentation approach based on the 3D-Unet network architecture, with the aim of achieving high-quality three-dimensional reconstruction. This method introduces a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) attention module into the conventional 3D-Unet structure to enhance feature representation, while also integrating Pixel Attention and residual connections to further optimize model performance. Through refined model training experiments, notable improvements in image segmentation accuracy are achieved. Additionally, successful 3D reconstruction of brain tumor segmentation images and cerebral images using the Monte Carlo (MC) Algorithm and light projection algorithm is achieved, which provides richer information for medical image visualisation research.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation of Lithium Battery Model Based on Improved Extended Kalman Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Energy storage battery pack is the core component of the seismic station energy supply, to ensure the seismic station green economy, safe and stable operation, improve the lithium battery charge state accurate estimation, is proposed based on adaptive particle swarm improved estimate battery State-of-Charge extension Kalman filter algorithm, through the forgetting factor recurrence multiplication online identification battery model parameters based on the SOC estimate, the Adaptive Mixovariation Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm optimization Extended Kalman Filter algorithm noise variance matrix, and the system and the measurement noise matrix optimization, further improve the estimation accuracy of SOC. The results show that the AMPSO-EKF algorithm can accurately identify the battery model parameters and the SOC values, and can correct the initial error of the state variable well.

articleTitle: Study on the Rapid Parametric Modeling Method of Armored Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The study of parametric modeling of armored vehicles is a key content in terms of target vulnerability research. This paper describes the functional requirements and structural hierarchy of the system of armored vehicles. Based on QT platform and SQLITE database platform, starting from the parametric drive, we proposed a relatively practical parametric fast modeling method for armored vehicles. The armored vehicle model can meet the requirements of battlefield target vulnerability research, which is a practical modeling method and can provide reference for the study of armored vehicle vulnerability in engineering.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Anti-tank Rejector Blast Damage Calculations
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to study the damage law of anti-tank horse repellent by charge explosion, ANSYS/LS-DYNA software was used to carry out numerical simulation calculation of anti-tank horse repulsion explosion damage, and the kinetic response process of anti-tank horse repulsion under two doses of 500kg and 1000kg and different burst distances was analyzed, and the damage mode and critical detonation distance of anti-tank horse repulsion were obtained. The results show that the anti-tank horses near the explosion source mainly have serious bending and deformation, tumbling and being swept away. The anti-tank horse deformation damage at a distance from the explosion source is less obvious, and it is mainly manifested as overall tumbling or translation. For the anti-tank horse rejection array, when the burst distance is small, the horse rejection is affected by the shock wave and scatters backwards, and it is distributed in an arc along the shock wave front, and the distance between the horse rejection is significantly increased. When the burst distance is large, the repellent horse rolls backwards for a shorter stroke and forms a buildup. Taking the maximum distance between the horses as the damage standard, the critical bursting distance of the anti-tank anti-tank anti-horse formation damage under 500kg of charge is 11 times the charge radius, and the critical bursting distance of 1000kg of medicine is 10 times the charging radius.

articleTitle: Research on SAR Image Ship Target Detection Algorithm with Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the issue of low detection accuracy in SAR image ship detection tasks, particularly in complex environments like small target ships and coastal ports, an improved YOLOv7-based algorithm is proposed. The bi Directional Feature Pyramid Network is introduced to simplify the network structure and improve the performance and feature representation ability of the network. The introduction of EIOU loss function is to replace the CIOU loss function used in the original model. This improvement makes the object detection network perform better in handling multi-scale targets, thereby reducing the problem of error detection and localization. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved model achieves a 1.08% increase in mAP on the SAR Chip Dataset, confirming the enhanced target detection performance of ships in SAR images.

articleTitle: Research on Indoor Localization Method Based on Smartphone WiFi-Sound Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Over the past few years, indoor positioning technology has advanced significantly, allowing researchers to determine a user's location using sensor data generated by smartphones. However, single-sensor localization techniques exhibit poor accuracy and stability. To address this issue, a fusion localization scheme based on the K-means clustering algorithm at the decision level has been employed. By utilizing the WiFi sensor and sound sensor within the smartphone, designed experiments are conducted and compared with a single algorithm to evaluate the localization performance of the fusion approach. The experimental results demonstrate that the fusion algorithm exhibits higher localization accuracy compared to single-sensor localization techniques.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of a Low Fuel Consumption Scheduling Model for Mining Trucks in Open-pit Mines
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper presents a scheduling scheme based on a convolutional neural network to predict the fuel consumption of mining trucks and select the most fuel-efficient path. By collecting the driving data of mining trucks, taking into account the different situations of different factors affecting fuel consumption of mining trucks under different states of full load and no load, the dispatching system can predict the path with the lowest fuel consumption of the mining trucks. The scheme can achieve the same task with the lowest fuel consumption. The scheduling scheme can help the mine control the cost and improve the utilization rate of mine resources and has certain significance for the economic and green development of open-pit mines.

articleTitle: Method of Thickness Measurement of Liquid Crystal Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The thickness of a liquid crystal (LC) cell is one of the main parameters of liquid crystal devices (LCD). This paper proposes a measurement method based on the multiple-beam interference between the two substrates of the LC cell. The transmitted beam after passing through the LC cell is collected and measured by a fiber optic spectrometer. The interference spectrum data is automatically analyzed through a Matlab program and the thickness of the LC cell is identified. Two LC cell samples with the thicknesses of 4 μm and 10 μm are tested with this method, and the tested results are 3.95 μm and 9.16 μm, respectively. The experimental results show that this proposed method is simple, efficient, and highly accurate.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Construction of Network Security Domain Based on Bi-LSTM-GNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to address the increasingly serious threats to cyberspace security, this study focuses on network security events as the research subject. It designs and implements a Knowledge Graph system based on deep learning and proposes a recognition model using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Graph Neural Network (Bi-LSTM-GNN) for constructing the Knowledge Graph in the field of network security. The model effectively captures contextual sequence information through a Bi-LSTM neural network and performs relationship extraction using graph convolutional networks, ensuring the retention of key information while removing irrelevant details. The model achieves high accuracy, recall, and F1 values of 90.2%, 84.5%, and 85.9% respectively on the test dataset, surpassing other models. Experimental results demonstrate the strong performance of the proposed Bi-LSTM-GNN model in identifying knowledge entities in the network security domain.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Tubing Leakage Based on PCA-SVM in Gas Well
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Tubing leakage gas wells has always been a common problem in oil and gas production. Due to the complex and harsh working conditions of the downhole tubing, the tubing is usually corroded, cracked, perforated, etc. The sealing failure or performance degradation of the tubing will cause leakage, and the tubing leakage will directly threaten the production security of gas wells. In this paper, the experiment of the leakage point at different positions is carried out by using the visual tubing leakage experiment system. Multiple features are extracted and compared. Based on the features extracted from multiple samples, a tubing leakage identification model based on Principal Component Analysis - Support Vector Machine (PCA-SVM) is established. The accuracy rate is 98.33 %, which can effectively identify the tubing leakage, and is of great significance for ensuring the production safety of offshore gas wells.

articleTitle: Research on Facial Expression Recognition Algorithm Based on Improved StarGAN Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: TO address the issue of overfitting in deep learning testing and pattern collapse in traditional generative adversarial networks (Gans),an based on deep learning improved Star Generative Adversarial network (StarGAN) facial expression recognition method is proposed. For this method, the regular term of pattern search and reconstruction loss are combined to improve the quality of the generated images and solve the problem of model pattern collapse. spatially separable convolution is used to extract image features to make a large number of parameters and operation cost is reduced. SVM is used for multi-task classification to improve the model generalization ability. Good recognition results were obtained on FER2013 data sets.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Models for Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In response to the challenges faced by existing Chinese cybersecurity named entity recognition models regarding the handling of Chinese language complexity and ambiguity during training, which utilizes a mixed corpus of Chinese and English in the network security vertical domain. The model is named BERT-BiGRU-Self-Attention-CRF. This model addresses the issue of polysemy by utilizing BERT to process cybersecurity texts and obtain contextual representations for each word. Then, the obtained word vectors are processed forward and backward in a Bidirectional Gated Recursive Unit (BiGRU) to better capture the contextual dependencies of the required network security related data. Inputting the output of the BiGRU layer into an attention mechanism allows the attention mechanism to assign different weights to each word in the sentence. Finally, a conditional random field is employed for data labeling, accurately annotating the entities. Through relevant comparative experiments, under the same experimental environment, F1 value of the model has enhanced by 3.46% contrasted to the LSTM-CRF model. In addition, compared model based on pre trained model BERT, F1 score increased by 1.84%. Compared to the BiGRU model with BERT, the F1 score is 0.80% higher. These findings fully demonstrate the significant role and advantages of the model in the vertical domain of Chinese English mixed cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Design of Anti-freezing Control System for Express Cabinet Based On Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In view of the problem that the temperature in northern China is too low in winter, and the outdoor express cabinet can't be opened due to freezing, while the temperature in summer is too high, and online shopping fresh products are prone to rot in the express cabinet, an anti-freezing temperature control system for express cabinet based on App is designed. The system adopts modular and hierarchical design, and uses App(mobile application) to connect ESP8266 module to realize remote control of STM32 single chip microcomputer and remote temperature adjustment. The system uses DS18B20 for temperature detection, and uses STM32F103C8T6 as the main controller to complete key scanning, LCD display, WiFi connection, temperature control and other functions. The system has simple circuit, convenient application, low power consumption and high precision, and has a certain market application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Retinex Traffic Sign Image Enhancement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This article proposes an improved Retinex image enhancement algorithm applied in the field of traffic sign recognition through in-depth research in the field of image processing. In the traditional Retinex algorithm, there are often problems such as blurred images, distorted image colors, and foggy weather images when the light is too dark. Improve and optimize the algorithm to effectively improve the recognition ability of traffic sign images. It avoids the phenomenon of images being too dark, low contrast, and foggy in harsh environments, and is superior in maintaining edges, details, and colors.

articleTitle: Remaining Life Prediction of Lithium Battery Based on Data Preprocessing CNN-GRU Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to overcome the non-stationarity and non-linearity of the capacity change of traditional lithium batteries during cyclic charging, which will be affected by the regeneration capacity change when life prediction is carried out, a neural network lithium battery life prediction technique using Whale Optimisation Algorithm (WOA) optimised Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) combined with Gated Recycling Unit (GRU) is proposed. Firstly, the number of decomposition layers and penalty factor in the VMD were optimised by WOA, secondly, the optimised VMD was used to divide the capacity of Li-ion batteries into several components, and in the third step, the CNN-GRU neural network model was used for prediction. The WOA-VMD-CNN-GRU model is validated by NASA dataset, and the experimental results show that compared with other methods such as CNN, GRU, feed-forward neural network (FNN), the results of this study have a maximum average absolute error of no more than 0.0092, a maximum root-mean-square error of no more than 0.0096, a minimum relative accuracy of 0.9937, and a maximum prediction error of no more than 2 cycles for RUL, indicating that the study has a maximum prediction error of no more than 2 cycles. exceed 2 cycles, indicating that the study has good robustness and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Vehicle Access Monitoring System Based on Radio Frequency Identification Technology Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the ongoing progress of the contemporary economy and technology, there has been a notable surge in the quantity of vehicles in China. Consequently, there is a pressing requirement for an automated, secure, dependable, efficient, and computerized vehicle access monitoring system. In this study, RFID technology is employed, alongside the client program structure, SQLite database management system, .NET Framework 4.8 as the development environment, Visual Studio 2019 as the development platform, Winforms as the development framework, and C# language for coding. The primary objective is to design and evaluate a warehouse vehicle access monitoring system that not only satisfies the demands of information interaction, but also ensures optimal functionality.

articleTitle: Research on LiFi Modulation Technology in Deep Mines
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: LiFi modulation technology is an important technology of Light Fidelity (LiFi) in optical wireless communication, which aims to ensure the bit error rate of information transmission in harsh channel environments. In deep mines, the propagation path of LiFi optical signals is interfered by the special environment of the tunnel, which reduces the performance of the overall LiFi system. Therefore, the design of LiFi modulation technology becomes extremely challenging. The current intensity modulation/direct detection (IM/DD) the relatively high bit error rate (BER) problem of the system is not satisfactory. This paper proposes an optical signal compensation mechanism to deal with the bit error rate problem, and conducts simulation analysis to prove that the mechanism has stable bit error rate performance.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Multi-hop Routing Protocol Based on LEACH
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the integration of wireless sensor networks into various fields, people's lives are increasingly dependent on their existence, and a large demand has prompted researchers to continuously study network protocols to improve network performance. The Energy Saving Multi-hop Routing Protocol Based on LEACH, an enhancement of the LEACH protocol, prioritizes energy conservation by considering the energy reserves and geographical distribution of nodes during cluster head selection. It incorporates a multi-hop transmission model to optimize data dissemination efficiency. Simulation results indicate that the proposed protocol achieves a significant reduction in energy use for network nodes compared to LEACH, directly contributing to a longer network lifespan.

articleTitle: Research on Intrusion Detection Technology Based on Ensemble Learning and Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the development and progress of network technology, network played an increasingly important role in modern life, but with the wide application of network, network security incidents also come, and the overall number of each year has maintained a continuous rising trend. In the face of increasing network intrusion threats, how to effectively identify malicious traffic from network traffic became more and more important, and the research in the field of intrusion detection has developed from the traditional single machine learning algorithm to the combination of multiple algorithms. In this paper, Tree-ensemble, which is a combination of Ensemble learning and decision Tree algorithm, was proposed to carry out the research on intrusion detection technology. KDD99 was selected as the intrusion detection data set, the eigenvalue selection algorithm based on random forest is used to sort the importance of features, and 44 eigenvalues are selected as the classification features of normal traffic and malicious traffic. Decision tree, Random forest, Extreme tree, AdaBoosting Adaptive Boosting, Gradient Boosting Decision Tree, XGBoost, Ensemble Voting (soft-voting),Ensemble Stacking (Logistic Regression as meta-classifier) were used to build a classification model for security analysis of data KDD99. Among the constructed classification models, the XGBoost algorithm model performed best, and the models constructed by the collective voting (soft voting) and set superposition (logistic regression as a meta-classifier) methods performed well.

articleTitle: The Propagation Characteristics of Shallow Sea Seismic Waves on the Surface of Buried Bodies Using Staggered Grid Finite Difference Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of anti-mine technologies such as mine sweeping and noise reduction, the cost-effectiveness ratio of conventional mines has significantly decreased. To enhance the target detection capability of mines, it is necessary to research other technologies. Therefore, it is necessary to study the propagation characteristics of shallow sea seismic waves on the surface of buried bodies. In this paper, the staggered grid finite difference method is used to simulate the propagation of shallow sea seismic waves on the surface of buried bodies. The main analysis focuses on the influence of burial depth, burial body size, and physical parameters of burial bodies on the propagation characteristics of shallow sea seismic waves on the surface of buried bodies. The results show that burial depth has a relatively small impact on the shallow sea seismic waves on the surface of buried bodies, The size and physical parameters of the burial body have a significant impact on the shallow sea seismic waves on the surface of the burial body.

articleTitle: High Performance Target Detection Based on Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In modern computer vision tasks, Swin Transformer is an emerging deep learning model architecture that innovates on the basis of the traditional transformer architecture by the introduction of a mechanism of attention called Shifted Windows to improve the performance and efficiency of the model. This paper presents a novel target detection method based on the original YOLOv5 detection model. The method combines the multi-layer attention mechanism of Swin Transformer with adaptive features and introduces Swin Transformer as a backbone network to replace the original backbone network. On the one hand, swin transformer is used as the backbone network of the target detection, which adopts the multi-layer attention mechanism to perform self-attention operation on features with different scales, and divides the feature map of the target image through the window shift mechanism to achieve the fusion of multiple disjoint regions. On the other hand, swin transformer's adaptive ability in multi-scale and multi-level feature representation enables it to achieve more accurate data analysis, thus achieving high performance target detection and multi-scale perception.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Action Time Window of Financial Support Policy Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As China's financial market opens up and innovation accelerates, regional financial risks have gradually emerged and become one of the key concerns of current financial regulation. This project takes Liaoning Province as an example, takes the spatio-temporal correlation between financial regulation and economic development as the research object, and selects a total of 16 mixed-frequency sample indicator pools representing the state of economic and financial development from five dimensions. Recurrent neural network (RNN) in deep learning is used as the basis for model construction to fit the trend of GDP under different circumstances. The effectiveness of regional financial regulation policies is explained from a quantitative perspective. The optimal time window for the introduction of financial support policies is found through model generalization. This research will play a crucial role in systematically preventing regional financial risks, giving full play to the incentive effect of policies, and better leading economic development.

articleTitle: Fully Convolutional Transformer for Malignancy Estimation of Pulmonary Nodule
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The fine-grained characteristics inherent in medical imaging represent one of the most significant distinctions from regular images, a distinction that has resulted in suboptimal performance of Transformers in this domain. Traditional convolutional neural networks, exemplified by ResNet, leverage residual structures to deepen the network, thereby offering hierarchical feature information for fine-grained attribute classification, a capability not present in existing Transformer-based models. In this study, we utilize a fully convolutional Transformer model that merges broad convolution with the self-attention mechanism. This model's overall architecture adheres to the traditional down-sampling pattern found in ResNet, effectively modeling both long and short-term dependencies in the input. The model operates in two stages: extracting long-term semantic information and capturing layered global attributes from the features, resulting in a more compact and robust structure overall. We trained this model using samples and labels extracted from the LIDC-IDRI dataset, enabling us to perform a detailed classification of the malignancy levels of lung nodules. According to our results, this model effectively mitigates overfitting, outperforming both Transformer and ResNet on this dataset. Furthermore, it demonstrates a high level of predictive accuracy on a test set with a limited number of small cell lung cancer samples.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Based Exercise Instruction Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Due to the lack of fitness exercise foundation, leisure time, the limitations of the sports ground, and other factors. A fitness exercise guidance system is designed to help people exercise effectively. In this paper, the improved OpenPose model is used to collect the skeletal information of the human body, and the collected information is normalized. The pose vector cosine distance is introduced to represent the single-frame similarity. The motion sequences are compared with the standard sequences, and the dynamic regularization algorithm is used to calculate the overall similarity and provide real-time feedback on motion correction. Finally, the overall network is applied to the baduanjin fitness exercise, which has the significance of promotion.

articleTitle: An Improved Shadow Detection Algorithm Based on Multi-features
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy of traditional shadow feature-based detection methods, an automatic shadow detection method fusing multiple features is proposed, which combines a multi-scale pyramid, Mean Shift segmentation, and SVM classifier. Firstly, a multi-scale image pyramid is constructed and the images are preprocessed with weighted median filtering to reduce noise and improve image quality. Then, Mean Shift segmentation is performed on all the images to split them into multiple sub-regions, features are extracted for each sub-region and these features and their corresponding labels are put into an SVM classifier for training to obtain the final shaded regions. The method incorporates an image pyramid mechanism, which reduces the image resolution through downsampling operations, decomposes the original image into sub-images at multiple scales while retaining the main information of the image, and improves the accuracy and robustness of the algorithm by increasing the accuracy and robustness of feature extraction. The experimental results show that the proposed shadow detection method obtains good performance and has a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Abnormal Traffic Detection Based on Data Augmentation and Hybrid Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low detection rate caused by class imbalance and limited detection ability of single model in abnormal traffic detection, an abnormal traffic detection model based on hybrid sampling and deep learning has been proposed. On the basis of using Tomek-Link method to filter noise samples in data, CTGAN technology is used to generate minority samples that conform to the original data distribution, make the samples tend to balance. By combining the advantages of convolutional neural network and bidirectional long short term memory network, the spatial and temporal features of network data are extracted in depth to further improve the overall detection performance of the model. The multi-classification experimental results on the NSL-KDD dataset show that the accuracy and recall of the proposed algorithm. The rates were increased by 12.06% and 11.53%, respectively, which verified the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: An Improved Lane Detection Algorithm Based on Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To minimize the incidence of erroneous detections of lane identification algorithm under different road environment such as shadow occlusion of lane line and white phenomenon of road surface. This paper presents an improved hybrid deep neural network model for lane identification by utilizing a series of consecutive frames captured from driving scenes. Based on SegNet-ConvLSTM network, this paper introduced Focal loss function and added improved channel attention mechanism and Bp-ASPP pyramid, so that the enhanced network could further extract image features and aggregate context information of different regions on the basis of the original network. Experiments were carried out on TuSimple dataset, and the accuracy of the proposed method was significantly improved compared with the previous method, which verified the proficiency of the approach.

articleTitle: Improved Classification of CT images of Cooropneumonia Based on ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In the CT image diagnosis of COVID-19, use traditional convolutional neural network such as ResNet to extract the feature of target will lose the information between the channel and the space, and when performing convolutional subsampling, more details of the image will be lost. In order to overcome the defect, we propose an improved ResNet50 network model, which introduces a CBAM attention mechanism after each residual module of ResNet50. In the fourth and fifth parts of ResNet50, convolutions with a convolution core size of 3 are transformed into empty convolutions. When training data, a transfer learning method based on fine tuning is used. The experiment shows that the improved ResNet50 on the COVID-19 CT dataset have high recognition accuracy than AlexNet, VGG16, and GoogleNet. Accuracy of improved ResNet50 model is 98.901%, which is 6.593 and 1.099 percentage points than original model and transfer learning model. Compared with the traditional convolutional neural network, the improved model proposed in this paper has greatly improved the recognition accuracy of COVID-19.

articleTitle: Damage Efficiency and Evaluation of Explosive-killing Projectiles on Typical Ship Targets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to study and analyze the damage efficiency of naval gun weapon system on maritime ship targets, this paper combines the power parameters of ammunition and the vulnerability model of the target to establish a reasonable damage efficiency evaluation model. Based on the damage evaluation model, the quantitative calculation and analysis of the damage efficiency of ammunition on the target. Set different attack schemes, so as to more comprehensively and detailedly study and analyze the damage efficiency of naval gun weapon system on maritime ship targets. For different CEP, terminal velocity and angle conditions of ammunition, the damage probability of the target is calculated, and on the basis of the damage probability, the amount of ammunition required to achieve different damage levels of the target is calculated and analyzed, which more directly reflects the impact of different attack conditions on the damage efficiency. The damage efficiency evaluation model and the obtained data can provide technical support for the subsequent design and optimization of ammunition.

articleTitle: SlowFast Action Recognition Network Based on Improved Residual Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The SlowFast action recognition network, built upon the ResNet3D-50 backbone, excels at capturing video information across different temporal scales. However, it falls short in leveraging global spatiotemporal context information when handling complex spatiotemporal features, which hampers its ability to model fine-grained changes and long-term dependencies in actions. To address these issues, this study introduces the Contextual Transformer (CoT) module into the SlowFast network. By integrating static context encoding and dynamic context learning, the CoT module enables efficient attention to global spatiotemporal features. It replaces the 1×3×3 convolutions in some residual blocks of ResNet3D-50, resulting in the proposed CoT-SlowFast network. Experiments conducted on the Atomic Visual Actions(AVA) dataset focused on eight action categories (four person interaction actions and four object manipulation actions). The results demonstrate that the CoT-SlowFast network improves accuracy by 1.39% for person interaction actions and by 0.32% for object manipulation actions, with an overall average improvement of 0.88% compared to the SlowFast network. In summary, the introduction of the CoT module into the CoT-SlowFast network effectively enhances action recognition accuracy, validating its efficacy in modeling complex spatiotemporal features.

articleTitle: An Improved Human Pose Estimation Algorithm Based on High-Resolution Net Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The convolution kernel used in the High-Resolution Net (HRNet) model for the initial extraction of features is single in size, which does not fully combine the context information, resulting in weak feature extraction ability, and the convolution operation mainly focuses on the extraction of local features, which has limitations in capturing long-distance features and inter-channel features. In order to solve the above problems, a multi-scale feature fusion module is introduced, and a dilated convolution and 1×1 convolution are introduced for multi-scale feature extraction, and then the weights of the fused features are adaptively redistributed through the concatenation of Channel Attention(CA) and Spatial Attention(SA) modules. By introducing the channel prior convolutional attention(CPCA) module, and by constructing the CPCA-based bottleneck module CPCA-Bottleneck, the attention weights can be dynamically distributed in the channel and spatial dimensions, and the feature extraction ability can be further improved. Experimental results show that this method can effectively alleviate the above problems and improve the accuracy of human key point prediction.

articleTitle: Autonomous Driving Decision Algorithm based on Hierarchical Dueling Double Deep Q-Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The sparse reward in traditional reinforcement learning will lead to poor training effect of autonomous vehicles. This paper proposes a hierarchical automatic driving decision method based on reinforcement learning. The multi-modal fusion of camera images and radar data ensures the state input of autonomous vehicles. The action space is divided into high-level options and low-level actions. The high-level option network and the underlying action network are built respectively. The vehicle interacts with the environment to learn the optimal driving strategy. Through simulation experiments, compared with DDDQN and DQN algorithms, the average speed of autonomous vehicles based on HDDDQN increases by about 4.48%, the average number of lane changes decreases by about 4.54%, and the average number of overtaking increases by about 18.6 %. Therefore, the safety and driving efficiency of automatic driving are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Text Classification Based on Multi-Head Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of traditional classification methods in single text information extraction, this paper proposes a multi-head attention classification model that introduces a bias term. The model employs a multi-head attention mechanism in place of a single attention mechanism to obtain effective information from multiple perspectives. By introducing bias vectors in each attention head, the model is able to focus on different aspects of the input in multiple dimensions, thus capturing key information more accurately. In this paper, the researchers carried out experiments using the IMDB dataset. The findings demonstrate that the suggested model displays notable enhancements in text categorization tasks, thus confirming the efficacy of the approach.

articleTitle: Improved Radon Transform and Differential Autocorrelation Based Motion Blur Parameter Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Restoring of motion blurred image is an important research direction in digital image processing technology, which is of great importance in many fields including aerospace, remote sensing technology, medical image processing and so on. However, the existing motion fuzzy parameter is still inaccurate when solving the length and angle imprecisely, which impact the restoration of motion blurred images. The paper proposes improvement methods for this problem. First, Radon transform is accepted in measuring relative motion angle in image pre-processing. Least squares line fitting based accurate angle estimation algorithm is proposed for small blur length. Second, an improved method based on differential autocorrelation length estimation is obtained for high accurate relative motion length estimation. In addition, this paper proposes the corresponding motion fuzzy parameter estimation algorithm for the images with different fuzzy degrees to make the estimation results more accurate.Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can estimate motion blur parameters more accurately. The restored image is superior to the existing methods in both subjective and objective. The proposed method is of great importance in engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Unmanned Mine Truck in Open-pit Mine Based on Vehicle-road Coordination
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To facilitate the implementation of unmanned trucks in open-pit mines, this paper explores the essential technologies for path planning for unmanned truck. It proposes a novel research approach, advocating for the organic integration of vehicle-road cooperation and path planning for unmanned truck. And this paper proposes a R-PSO algorithm based on return value for the sudden accident in the open-pit mine area. The simulation results show that the algorithm has better optimization ability, faster convergence speed and shorter time consumption than the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Improved Variable Step Size LMS Algorithm Based on Artanh Function
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The LMS algorithm with a fixed step size cannot simultaneously achieve excellent performance on convergence rate and steady state error in practical applications. This paper proposes a variable step length LMS algorithm (IAVSLMS) based on artanh function, and constructs a new relationship between step length parameter and error signal by improving the parameter model structure, removing small square operation and adopting the error correlation function. The new algorithm is more computational and conducive for hardware implementation. The simulation results show that the new algorithm performs well in convergence speed, steady state error, and tracking performance.

articleTitle: Line Laser Vision-Guided Weld Seam Tracking System Research
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Traditional welding robot processing relies heavily on demonstration teaching or offline programming, resulting in low flexibility and poor adaptability in the production process. Under the influence of complex and changing welding environment, there are still difficulties in weld seam recognition; when the position of the weldment is shifted or deformed by the high temperature of the welding torch, it will cause the error between the actual welding trajectory and the preset trajectory. This paper mainly focuses on the optimization and innovation of weld seam image recognition, after completing the calibration of each part of the welding system, using convolutional neural network to detect and recognize the weld seam, and carrying out a series of processing for the collected images, on this basis, it is proposed to establish an improved Faster Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks model, adjust and optimize the model structure, and at the same time, use the Feature Pyramid Networks algorithm for target detection. Through the comparison of the detection performance of different networks, it is proved that the improved Faster-RCNN network is more accurate in weld seam detection.

articleTitle: Design of Lithium Battery Intelligent Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Lithium batteries have the advantages of safe and reliable power supply, low maintenance costs, small footprint, often used as the preferred solution for power supply in data centers. To solve the problems of non-linear charging and discharging curves in lithium batteries, and uneven charging and discharging caused by multiple lithium batteries in series and parallel, we design an intelligent comprehensive management system for lithium power batteries used for data centers. This system includes a master control module and a slave control module. The latter is mainly responsible for collecting voltage, current, and temperature information of lithium batteries; The main control module will perform fault detection, estimate battery charge state estimation algorithm, display data on LCD screen, and communicate with the upper computer using CAN protocol based on the information collected from the control module, transmitting the battery data situation to the user in real-time. This system uses the Internet of Things communication technology to obtain the battery status information collected on the main control board, realize the information interaction between the computer and the lithium Battery management system, and design and optimize the state of charge estimation algorithm to improve the accuracy of lithium battery data so as to improve the security and stability of the lithium battery management box. Compared with existing technologies, the accuracy of the state of charge (SOC) estimation algorithm has been improved by using an improved ampere hour integration method combined with a neural network. At the same time, the system can transmit data to users in real time, further ensuring the security of the data center.

articleTitle: Multi-scale complex terrain wind power output prediction based on multi-feature refinement fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Reliable wind power output (WPO) prediction is a security guarantee for high penetration power systems from wind power. Currently, the utilization of artificial intelligence prediction models in WPO prediction does not fully exploit data features, leading to a lack of accuracy in output prediction. To improve the accuracy and robustness of WPO prediction, this study proposes a model based on K-Medoids-temporal convolutional networks-gated recurrent unit (K-Medoids-TCNGRU) for multi-feature refinement fusion, considering multi-scale complex terrain. Firstly, the raw data is divided into multiple spatial scales utilizing a multi-scale approach. Secondly, dual channel input of weather data and historical WPO data. Thirdly, weather data are divided by the K-Medoids clustering into two separate classes for prediction utilizing GRU and historical WPO for prediction utilizing TCN. Finally, the prediction results are fed into a fully connected neural network for decision-level fusion. In addition, this study replaces all dropout layers with Monte Carlo dropout layers and averages the multiple predictions to improve the certainty of the results. A dataset provided by a region of Natal, Brazil, is utilized to predict the WPO of the region for a day. Experimental results show that K-Medoids-TCN-GRU has a 17.4421 lower root mean square error than the highest performing GRU of the comparison model, validating the K-Medoids-TCN-GRU as more accurate and robust.

articleTitle: Whale Optimization Algorithm Based on Chaotic Mapping and Dynamic Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To tackle the shortcomings of the original WOA, including its sluggish convergence rate and tendency to approach local optima, an adaptive whale optimization algorithm (MWOA) combining chaotic maps and dynamic parameters is presented. First, a modified tent map was employed to create the whale population, increasing its diversity and distributing it more evenly. Then, to strengthen and balance the capabilities of global and local search, the adaptive weight coefficient is added and the linear convergence factor is modified. Finally, the findings of simulation trials on six test functions demonstrated that MWOA considerably increased convergence accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Adaptive FCM Clustering Routing Algorithm Based on PSO Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To solve the problems of large node energy consumption and missing data transmission path in Marine sensor networks, a clustering routing algorithm utilizing particle swarm optimization (PSO-DAFCA) was introduced. The algorithm uses fuzzy C-means method of particle swarm optimization to optimize cluster head selection and cluster member configuration, and selects the best cluster head by dynamically updating cluster center. During the data transmission phase, combined with the global search ability of cat swarm optimization algorithm, the path evaluation function based on energy and distance parameters is introduced to determine the optimal transmission route. Simulation results indicate that the PSO-DAFCA algorithm can enhance network energy efficiency, prolong network lifespan, and improve the real-time accuracy of marine environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: An Improved Image Defogging Algorithm Based on Dehazenet Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The image dehaze technology is particularly important. This paper adopts the traditional physical model and deep learning network model approach, using the improved dehazenet network, using three different scales of convolution kernel for feature extraction of the original foggy image, and in the feature learning process using 3×3 tiny convolutional kernel to increase the model’s depth; in order to avoid the network overfitting as well as to enhance the convergence speed of the network, the batch after convolution was added Batch Normalization processing is added after the convolution to estimate the transmittance t , and the original bootstrap filter is improved to a weighted bootstrap filter so as to better strengthen the edge information, and the quadtree method is used to estimate the atmospheric light value A instead of the original method to ensure a more accurate estimation of the atmospheric light. Using RESIDE dataset, the outdoor image with sky, the building image and the indoor restaurant image are used for the defogging experiments and the three values of PSRN, MSE and SSIM are evaluated.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Multiple Indexed Modulation Based OFDM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) indexed modulation systems achieve higher information transmission rates than orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) by selecting different combinations of subcarrier indexes to transmit additional information. In this paper, we investigate the effects of different sub-carrier activation ratios and modulation orders on the spectral efficiency and bit error rate performance of single-mode indexing (OFDM-IM) and dual-mode indexing (DM-OFDM), compare them with OFDM, and then analyze the intrinsic reasons and obtain the corresponding experimental conclusions, so as to provide data support for the design and application of more indexing modes.

articleTitle: An Optimized Deployment Method for Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Probability Density for Node Depth Self-Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: For applications requiring high node density and broad coverage, this paper introduces the area of Voronoi diagrams as sinking probabilities and proposes the Probability Density-based Deep Adjustment and Layered Deployment Algorithm (PDLDA). The aim is to achieve higher node coverage while minimizing the number of nodes to the maximum extent possible. Through the analysis of simulation experiment results, it is found that the PDLDA deployment algorithm, compared to other algorithms, can achieve a more uniform node distribution, improve coverage, significantly enhance network reliability, and effectively prolong the network's lifespan.

articleTitle: An Improved Pedestrian Detection Method Based on YOLOv5 Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In pedestrian detection research,, occlusion has always been an important challenge that requires immediate attention. In order to solve this predicament, an improved pedestrian detection method based on YOLOv5 was proposed. Firstly, the Mosaic9 data enhancement method was used in the data processing stage to enhance the training effect of the model and make the network more robust. Secondly, the Selective kernel attention mechanism is added to the Neck part of YOLOv5 to boost the characteristic extraction extraction in relation to occluded goals. Finally, the hierarchical pooling structure layer, Spatial Pyramid Pooling Fast(SPPF) within the foundational YOLOv5 framework algorithm was substituted by atrous space convolutional pooling pyramid Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling(ASPP) to enhance the model's perception scope the model. Experiments show that contrasted against the initial YOLOv5, average precision and recall rate have been greatly increased, so that the occlusion target can be effectively detected.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Detecting Human Fall Behavior Based on Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of fall detection algorithm such as large amount of calculation, poor real-time performance and difficulty in feature extraction, an improved fall detection algorithm based on human skeleton key point detection and multi-feature fusion was proposed. First, the main network of OpenPose is replaced with MobileNetV3 network, the size of the convolution kernel is adjusted from 7×7 to 3×3. Then, the multiple fall behavior features were fused, and the detection results were output by SVM classification. On the fall dataset, the proposed algorithm achieves high accuracy.

articleTitle: The Defect Detection Method for Automotive Parts Based on Improved Single Shot MultiBox Detector Using Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The application of machine vision systems holds significant potential for detecting the processing quality of automotive parts in industrial intelligent manufacturing. To overcome the limitations of traditional Single Shot Detector (SSD) algorithms in identifying defects in automotive parts, we propose an improved SSD method. This enhanced approach integrates a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into the feature extraction network. Within the CBAM, the spatial attention module increases the model’s sensitivity to features of the machined part of the workpiece, while the channel attention module enhances the model’s generalization in detection tasks. By up-sampling and fusing shallow and deep feature layers, we construct multi-scale feature information, significantly improving the detection capability for small targets such as holes and welded joints on workpieces. Additionally, we introduce Focal Loss to address sample category imbalance and reduce the model’s false alarm rate. Compared to the traditional SSD algorithm, our experimental results demonstrate that the mean average precision (mAP) of our model in workpiece defect detection is improved by approximately 10.3%, and the detection accuracy is increased by 16.1%. This advancement offers a robust solution for quality detection in the automotive parts processing industry.

articleTitle: A Power Consumption Prediction Method for Data Center Refrigeration System Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The energy consumption problem caused by data centers is becoming more and more serious, and air conditioning systems rank second only to IT equipment in terms of power consumption. Accurate prediction of air conditioning power consumption in data centers not only helps enterprises grasp the cost level of data centers, but also helps data centers to save energy and build green data centers. This paper presents an energy consumption prediction method for air-conditioning in data center based on LSTM network. This paper also utilizes simulation software to model data center facilities and simulate the power consumption necessary to maintain the air conditioning system under various conditions. The experimental results demonstrate that utilizing the LSTM neural network model results in more accurate predictions for air conditioning in data center facilities compared to the BP neural network model.

articleTitle: Image Processing Based on Inter-frame Color Feature Matching for Visible Light Positioning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The indoor imaging visible light positioning (VLP) technology based on the image sensor (IS) utilizes existing indoor lighting infrastructure to provide high-precision indoor positioning services. However, due to the high complexity of traditional image processing algorithms, existing VLP systems are unable to provide real-time positioning services. In response to the above issue, we propose an image processing mechanism based on the inter-frame color feature matching method, which includes the equidistant sampling processing, low complexity decoding algorithm, and color feature matching-based LED region of interest (ROI) determination method. The results show that the system average positioning delay is 80.2ms, indicating better system real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Based Traffic Sign Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Traffic signs as a small target, its fast and accurate detection in the complex traffic environment has certain practical significance. This paper focuses on the lack of traffic sign detection accuracy in complex and changing traffic scenes, and improves the YOLOv7 algorithm in deep learning to improve the accuracy of the current existing algorithms and meet certain real-time performance. Experimental comparisons were conducted on the TT100k dataset, and the improved method improved the accuracy of the model by 1.04%, the recall by 2.37%, and the mean average precision by 2.52% compared with YOLOv7. The trial report has shown that the improved algorithm can validly enhance the precision of traffic sign detection and significantly improve the misdetection and omission of small.

articleTitle: Optimization and Application of The Search Algorithm for The Efficacy of Airfield Blockade By Penetration Submunitions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In this paper, a new search algorithm in the assessment of airport runway damage is developed based on the vulnerability of airport runway targets. The calculation model of the damage effectiveness of submunitions on airport targets is established based on the Monte Carlo sampling method. On the basis of considering the influence of CEP on blocking efficiency, the applicable conditions of two types of search methods, window traversal method and window scanning method, are studied. The numerical results show that when the CEP of the parent projectile is smaller, the blocking probability of the two search algorithms is comparable; as the CEP of the parent projectile increases, the error of the window scanning method increases, and the value of the blocking probability is gradually larger; however, the window traversal method has lower computational efficiency, so in practical calculations, we can refer to the specific value of the CEP to select the corresponding search algorithm.

articleTitle: Self-exploding Insulator Detection for Transmission Lines Based on Improved YOLOv5s Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: For the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection of high-voltage transmission lines, the common detection methods have low detection accuracy, slow speed and unsatisfactory effect for insulator self-explosion defects. It is improved on the basis of You Only Look Once version 5s (YOLOv5s ) algorithm. Firstly, the lightweight FasterNeXt network is used in the backbone of the algorithm model to reduce its size and computation; secondly, the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) channel spatial attention module is added to enhance the ability of important feature extraction and improve network performance. The experimental results show a 1.1% increase in accuracy, an 8.9% reduction in the amount of parameters, a 7.5% reduction in floating-point operations, a 1.2M reduction in model size, and a 7Hz increase in detection speed FPS.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of AgI Catalyst Combustion Based on Fluent
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of high combustion temperature and unstable combustion of a certain rocket AgI catalyst. On the basis of the traditional basic components of AgI catalyst, such as ammonium perchlorate, silver iodide, potassium iodide, ammonium iodide, magnesium powder and neoprene rubber, magnesium powder was replaced by organic composite combustible agent, ammonium perchlorate was partially replaced by strontium nitrate as oxidant, and copper s alt was added to optimize the formulation. The combustion numerical simulation of the new formula was carried out by using Fluent software. The combustion temperature trend li ne is drawn by Matlab software to judge the dispersion degree and the combustion stability is judged by observing the combustion flame form. The results show that the combustion temperature of the new formula is lower than that of the original formula, the combustion is more stable, and the new formula can better fulfill the requirements of artificial rain enhancement and hail prevention.

articleTitle: Improved Human Pose Estimation Algorithm Based on HigherHRNet
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The problem of imbalance between foreground and background samples exists in the bottom-up human pose estimation method, while the high-resolution network cannot effectively obtain the channel information and spatial position information during feature extraction and feature fusion. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a bottom-up human pose estimation network based on the high-resolution network HigherHRNet and fused with pyramid network. The pyramid network can provide multi-scale feature representation according to different levels of sensory field size, extract contextual information from different levels of features as well as fusion between different levels of features to improve the feature expression capability. Combining the pyramid network with HigherHRNet can improve the performance of small human target detection. The detection and localization of small human targets can be effectively enhanced by multi-scale sensory fields, rich contextual information, feature fusion and scale adaptation, and the accuracy and robustness of the algorithm can be improved.

articleTitle: Research on Cellular Mechanical Properties for Lung Tumor Subtypes Classification and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Understanding the mechanical properties of cancer stem cells is important for studying the occurrence and development of cancer. However, little is known about the cellular mechanical properties of patients in clinical. In this paper, we explored the change laws and the intrinsic mechanisms of the mechanical properties of CSCs and tumor cells (TCs) from lung tumor patients and applied the cellular mechanical properties to lung tumor subtypes classification and prediction in clinical. Our results revealed significant differences in cellular mechanical properties between different tumor types, and the mechanical properties of single CSCs and TCs were used to classify the lung tumor subtypes with an accuracy of more than 90% in less than 5 hours, much faster than conventional techniques with about 5 days. Thus, our work has profound implications for cancer prediction and diagnosis.

articleTitle: Vehicle Small Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In response to the intelligence of modern transportation, the demand for vehicle detection has increased dramatically, and vehicles on urban roads often appear in the form of small targets in the video. However, encountering challenges such as limited image resolution, subtle target features, and a narrow field of view, which collectively hinder the effective detection of small objects, we have refined a YOLOv7-Tiny-based algorithm specifically tailored for small target detection. As a result, we have enhanced a small target detection approach utilizing the YOLOv7-Tiny framework to address the difficulties encountered in detecting minute objects.The CBAM attention mechanism is introduced into YOLOv7-Tiny, and the loss function is optimized using the NWD strategy. Finally, it is tested on the traffic camera detection dataset and compared with other target detection algorithms, and the improved network model can achieve 0.737 of mAP@0.5, which is 1.2 percentage points better than the baseline. The detection effect is better than other classical networks.

articleTitle: A Method for Generating Composite Chaotic Sequences
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional one-dimensional chaotic mapping generation method, which is simple and easy to be intercepted and cracked by the enemy in the transmission process, a method of generating composite chaotic sequences is proposed, and the complexity, balance, initial traversal, autocorrelation and inter-correlation of the composite chaotic sequences are tested. The simulation shows that the composite chaotic sequence can meet the requirements of pseudo-random sequence in spread spectrum communication and can be applied to spread spectrum communication.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Tandem Fixed-wing Unmanned Aerial Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the 3D model construction of a tandem-stage fixed-wing UAV and its kinematic simulation analysis. Through an in-depth understanding of the flight principle of a tandem-stage fixed-wing UAV, the equations of motion of this type of UAV are first constructed. Then the flight process of the UAV is exhaustively simulated and analysed using advanced kinematic analysis software. Under the set initial conditions, the dynamic relationship between the lift force and the flight speed and flight time of the UAV during the flight process was obtained, and the relationship between the thrust paddle centre-of-mass angular velocity amplitude, angular acceleration amplitude and the flight time was also explored, and the rule of change between the flight speed, lift force and flight time of the UAV was further analysed.The concluding data from these simulation analyses not only provide an important reference basis for the design optimisation of the tandem fixed-wing UAV, but also lay a solid theoretical foundation for subsequent experimental verification and practical application.

articleTitle: Research on the Distribution Pattern of Forward Shockwaves Before Underwater Weapon Launch
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to investigate the distribution pattern of the forward shock wave before the explosion of the energetic propellant underwater, we have constructed a simulation model for the underwater explosion of energetic propellant. Through simulation calculations, we have analyzed the distribution pattern of the peak pressure of the forward shock wave. The results indicate that the peak pressure and specific impulse of the underwater weapon’s forward shock wave are influenced by the structural design of the casing. A larger concave angle of the casing towards the loading direction corresponds to smaller peak pressure and specific impulse at the same position. The planar casing exhibits the greatest power of the shock wave, but fails to create a focused penetration effect, while the spherical casing achieves the highest overall power, satisfying the optimized matching conditions for jet and shock wave power.

articleTitle: Research Status of Virtual Power Plants Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the arrival of the Internet plus era, renewable energy has become the main direction of global development in the future. The data generated in the actual operation of the power grid also shows a massive and diverse trend, in order to tap the intrinsic value of power grid data. The use of modern technology to analyze data generated by the power grid plays a very important role in load control and scheduling of the power grid. This article takes virtual power plants as the main form of grid connection as the research object, mainly studying the application of big data technology in the direction of virtual power plants. Then, it analyzes the architecture of virtual power plants, and finally explores the future development direction of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: Research on Unsupervised Campus Audio Anomaly Detection Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to detect inappropriate speech in classrooms, this paper proposes an unsupervised model based on generative adversarial networks (GAN), which integrates an autoencoder structure to detect anomalies in uncalibrated classroom audio, saving a lot of labeling time. Enhance data by adding Latent Space Pitting and weight sharing. Meanwhile, due to the previous model being mostly used for two-dimensional image data, in order to enhance the learning ability of one-dimensional speech information features, a multi head attention mechanism was introduced. Experiments were conducted on a self-made classroom audio dataset, demonstrating that the proposed method can improve the ability of anomaly detection and effectively distinguish anomalies.

articleTitle: Object Action Recognition Algorithm Based on Asymmetric Fast and Slow Channel Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient video motion feature extraction and low recognition accuracy of the existing symmetric object action recognition model, we propose an asymmetric video object action recognition model that extracts content features from a single slow channel and motion features from two fast channels. A single slow channel extracts video content information; two fast channels extract the motion features of the video and uses the lateral connection to fuse the features with the slow channel. We obtain the object action recognition features after the extracted content features and motion features through global average pooling and concatenation operation, so as to realize the action recognition of motion objects. We conduct comparative experimental studies of different model architectures on the UCF101 and HMDB51 datasets. The experimental results show that the recognition results of the asymmetric object action recognition models Top1 and Top5 on UCF101 dataset are 1.32% and 1.51% higher than those of the symmetric SlowFast model, 4.44% and 4.05% higher on HMDB51 dataset, respectively. In addition, the influence of fast channels with different frame rates on the recognition results is studied in the constructed model, and the experimental results show that the recognition effect is the best when the frame rate α<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> is equal to 4 and α<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is equal to 8. Our proposed asymmetric model achieves good performance in object action recognition, which makes a clear contribution to these improvements.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Study of 30CrMnSiA Thin-walled Cylinders with Staggered Spinning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: 30CrMnSiA steel is widely used in the manufacture of rocket engine housings, and the staggered spinning process has become an advanced processing technology because of its small amount of stock removal when manufacturing thin-walled cylinders. ABAQUS software serves to simulate the process of staggered spinning molding for thin-walled shells. It is utilized to comprehensively analyze the impact of thinning rate and feed rate on the roundness accuracy of the outer diameter of the workpiece, as well as the spinning pressure. Furthermore, experiments are conducted to validate the obtained results, ensuring their accuracy and reliability. The findings indicate that the thinning rate and feed rate exert a significant influence on the precision of the workpiece. The optimal processing parameters are as follows: thinning rate of 45%, feed rate of 100mm/min, spindle speed of 100r/min, and spinning wheel fillet radius of 7mm. The experimental results confirm the feasibility of the molding program, and the dimensional accuracy achieved through the optimal spinning process holds significant reference value for the advancement of rocket engine case manufacturing technology.
