articleTitle: A Balanced Load Matching Rate Code Aware Routing Protocol based on network coding
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As the foundation of network communication, routing protocols have become one of the critical technologies for the development of marine resources and marine military. However, due to the characteristics of underwater Ad hoc networks, such as long delay, narrow bandwidth and high bit error rate, the data transmission ability of traditional routing protocol is poor. In this paper, with the help of the idea of coding-aware routing, using network coding techniques, a coding-aware multipath routing protocol BMCAR(Balanced Load Matching Rate Aware Routing) with a balanced load matching rate based on network coding suitable for underwater environments is designed, and the BMCAR routing protocol actively explores and utilizes potential coding opportunities in the network during route discovery. A new routing metric BMCRM(Balanced Load Matching Rate-Coding Aware Routing Metric)is designed as the routing criterion. BMCAR Routing Protocol makes the coding opportunity more accurate and further increases the throughput of the network. It makes the transmission more reliable and more practical.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Sparrow Neural Network Algorithm Based on Chaotic Mapping for Waste Quantity Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of waste generation predictions, a method incorporating chaotic mapping into the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) is proposed. This enhanced algorithm is then integrated with neural networks for more precise predictions. The SSA typically encounters issues like slow convergence and getting stuck in local optima during optimization. By introducing Tent and Sine chaotic maps, the algorithm's randomness and diversity are increased, enhancing the initial population quality. Neural network backpropagation is then used to update positions. Through comparative analysis of BP, SSA, and chaotic SSA neural networks, more accurate predictions of waste generation are achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Maximum Power Point Tracking Technology Based on Combined Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The photovoltaic array exhibits multiple peak power outputs under partial shading conditions. Traditional maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms can get stuck at local maximum power points. To address this issue, a novel MPPT algorithm is proposed based on a combination of the Tuna Swarm Optimization (TSO) and the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for photovoltaic systems. The algorithm achieves a complementary advantage of both methods, accelerating the convergence speed of the TSO in the later stages and avoiding the issue of the PSO easily falling into local optimal values. In the MATLAB/Simulink environment, a photovoltaic array simulation model is established. The simulation results indicate that the algorithm can quickly and accurately search for the global maximum power point.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Small Target Detection Research Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This study introduces a streamlined improvement algorithm based on YOLOv7 to address the challenges of multiple small targets, complex backgrounds, limited feature points, and environmental influences in remote sensing images. The algorithm incorporates the GSConv module and upsampling to achieve more effective feature fusion. The GSConv module combined with the VoV-GSCSP module achieves Slim-Neck for reducing algorithm complexity and improving accuracy. The Receptive Field Enhancement (RFE) module is introduced after the spatial pyramid pooling layer (SPPCSPC) to enhance the receptive field of small targets. By changing the settings of convolution operations and increasing the receptive field size of each convolutional layer, local and global features in the image are better captured. Information flow is maintained through skip connections. Experimental findings show that the enhanced YOLOv7 algorithm reaches an mAP of 95.5% on the NWPU VHR-10 dataset, marking a 6.4% improvement over the original algorithm’s mAP. That improves the accuracy of object detection in remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Research on the Confirmation Mechanism of Satellite Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In space links, due to the asymmetric bandwidth between forward and reverse links, reverse link congestion and low forward link throughput can occur. Therefore, the traditional Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) cannot meet the communication requirements of space links. To address this issue, this paper improves the original acknowledgment mechanism by using the concept of the Tamed Acknowledgment (TACK) mechanism, adjusting the frequency and amount of acknowledgment information returned without changing the TCP architecture. This enhances the reverse link's congestion resistance and increases the forward link's throughput. Simulations were conducted on the OMNeT++ platform, and the results demonstrate that this method can effectively alleviate reverse link congestion and improve network transmission performance in space links.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the issue of low real-time performance in traditional target detection algorithms for vehicle detection and tracking, low accuracy, and susceptibility to occlusion leading to omission and mixed detection, a deep learning-based vehicle detection algorithm is proposed. The algorithm incorporates a lightweight convolutional attention module (CBAM), improves the trunk-head network and introduces adaptive spatial feature fusion (ASFF) as well as a multi-branch RFB module layer on the basis of the original YOLOv5s network model. After the introduction of this algorithm, remarkable improvements are observed in detection accuracy, real-time performance, and the mitigation of occlusion-related issues like omission and mixing, surpassing the performance of traditional network applications.

articleTitle: Multiple Endmember Extraction Using Spatial-Spectral Information
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Spectral variability often occurs in hyperspectral remote sensing scenes. The traditional hyperspectral endmember extraction method ignores the influence of spectral variability, resulting in low accuracy of mixed pixel decomposition. In this work, a multiple endmember extraction algorithm based on spatial-spectral information is proposed for hyperspectral image(HSI). Firstly, the original hyperspectral image is divided into non-overlapping image blocks, and the traditional single endmember extraction algorithm is used to extract candidate endmembers on the image blocks. Secondly, the spectral similarity analysis is performed on the neighborhood pixels of the candidate endmembers to refine candidate endmembers. Finally, the clustering algorithm is used to cluster all endmember sets to obtain the final multiple endmember set. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has the ability to characterize the spectral variability in remote sensing images and can effectively improve the accuracy of mixed pixel decomposition.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Autoencoder for Lossy Compression of Auxiliary Physiological Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Auxiliary physiological indicator data, though less critical than key physiological indicator data for daily health monitoring, are crucial in specific research and clinical contexts. This paper proposes a lossy compression method using neural network autoencoders to enhance the energy efficiency of sensors collecting such data. Utilizing a fully connected neural network autoencoder, the method achieves an ultra-high compression ratio of 256:1. Simulations show excellent reconstruction of skin temperature data but poor performance with EDA data due to its higher precision and complexity. To address this, a new neural network module (EENM) replaces the middle layers of the original autoencoder, enhancing its expressive power. Simulation results indicate that the enhanced model significantly reduces reconstruction errors for both skin temperature and EDA data while maintaining the same compression ratio. This method demonstrates potential for energy-saving applications in auxiliary medical sensors and provides a valuable reference for future research.

articleTitle: SAE-WGAN Based Fault Diagnosis Method for Rolling Mills System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The performance and condition of the mill hydraulic automatic gauge control (AGC) hydraulic system has a direct impact on the final roll quality. This method combines stacked auto-encoders (SAE)and generative adversarial network (GAN), using fault signals collected from sensors, in depth training and simulation of fault data, and enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis by generative adversarial network to optimize the model's learning and realistic sample generation capability. The experimental results demonstrate that this method combining stacked auto-encoders and GAN is not only applicable to the complex AGC system of rolling mills, but also effective in guaranteeing the stable operation of the system, significantly reducing the fault rate, and improving the production efficiency.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-target Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5 Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Real-time detection of traffic participants such as vehicles and pedestrians is an important part of information interaction in today's society, but the low accuracy of multi-target detection in complex weather conditions and dense intersections is still a challenging problem. Therefore, this paper introduces a multi-object identification algorithm utilizing deep neural networks. Firstly, the SPPF component in the YOLOv5 network is substituted with SimSPPF, resulting in an expanded receptive field. Then, the SimAM attention mechanism module is attached to the backbone network of the YOLOv5 to enhance the extraction ability of the model and reduce the false detection rate. Finally, replace the loss function of YOLOv5 with the Varifocal Loss function, which can improve the model's detection ability for targets of different scales and sizes, making it more robust.

articleTitle: Adaptive Service Function Chain Orchestration Algorithm Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In traditional networks, service function chains consist of multiple network service devices that data flows traverse from source to destination, which leads to unnecessary resource waste due to issues like fixed network topology and deployments. SDN/NFV breakthroughs in decoupled control and hardware virtualization provide server virtualization techniques that lift limitations of traditional network bottom layer resources. This enables possibilities for reducing link latency and resource overhead to achieve adaptive orchestration.We propose DeepSFC, a distributed self-learning service chain orchestration method based on DRL. After offline training, the intelligent agents apply online with minimal overhead. Without requiring expert knowledge, they can make orchestration decisions by periodically observing environmental monitoring information. Each agent only observes its direct neighbors rather than requiring global knowledge. Compared to state-of-the-art heuristic and DRL algorithms, DeepSFC significantly improves throughput on real-world network topology and traffic traces (11% and 15%), while each online decision takes less time (1 ms).

articleTitle: Self-checkout Intelligent Recognition System for Fruit Supermarkets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In response to issues such as product barcode contamination and prolonged checkout waiting times during customers’ shopping process at supermarkets, this paper proposes a method for automatic identification of fruits and vegetables based on image recognition technology. The system utilizes TensorFlow to train two models, CNN and MobileNet, and compares their accuracy on the validation set. Ultimately, the MobileNetV2 model, which achieves higher accuracy, is selected to accomplish automatic fruit recognition. This checkout system can enhance customers’ shopping experience, improve sales efficiency, and reduce labor costs.

articleTitle: Study on the Combination of S-growth Curves Based on Ultra-Wideband Displacement Ranging for Predicting Landslides
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of landslide deformation prediction, a combination prediction method based on S-shaped growth curve is adopted to combine the Verhulst model and Pearl model, which are commonly used in landslide early warning and forecasting, with optimal weights, and the combination prediction model is applied to the UWB-based displacement ranging and deformation dataset for validation studies to realize the prediction of slope displacement changes. The results show that the Verhulst model is better than the Pearl model in the single prediction model, but the Pearl model is better in the fitting effect, while the combined prediction model based on the optimal weights can make full use of the advantages of the single prediction model, and can effectively improve the accuracy of the landslide deformation prediction. The combination prediction model based on optimal weights can fully utilize the advantages of a single prediction model and effectively improve the accuracy of landslide deformation prediction. The combination prediction model based on optimal weights can make full use of the advantages of a single prediction model and can effectively improve the accuracy of landslide deformation prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Nonnegative Matrix Decomposition Spectrum Perception Method Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the spectrum sensing performance of cognitive radio systems under low signal-to-noise ratio conditions, a non negative matrix decomposition spectrum sensing method based on convolutional neural networks is proposed. The core idea of this method is to use convolutional neural network structure to effectively extract spectral features, and combine non negative matrix decomposition technology to decompose and reconstruct the observed signals. Through this approach, noise and signal can be effectively distinguished, thereby improving the system's perception of the surrounding spectral environment. The simulation results show that this method has better perceptual performance than existing methods at a signal-to-noise ratio of -25dB~-5dB.

articleTitle: Research on Network Encrypted Traffic Detection Technology Based on CNN+LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In recent years, network security has received more and more attention in the identification of encrypted traffic, resulting in rapid progress in traffic classification research. Traffic protection measures such as network traffic obfuscation technology are constantly introduced into the Internet, which brings great challenges to efficient traffic classification. This paper proposes a method for classifying network traffic by utilizing a CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) and LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) model. The CNN model learns the spatial features of encrypted traffic, while the LSTM model analyzes the sequential features. The output results of both models are fused to classify the traffic. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves good accuracy, recall rate, and precision when compared to a one-dimensional CNN.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Restoration Based on Marine Snow Removal Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Image capture and analysis in underwater environments have applications in many fields, such as underwater archaeological exploration, deep-sea biological research, oil and gas resource exploration, and path navigation of intelligent underwater robots. Existing underwater image restoration methods usually face problems such as high model complexity and the inability to be deployed on actual underwater operating platforms. This paper proposes an efficient and fast underwater image restoration method called UIRF-Net to address these issues. This method can restore underwater images and remove marine snow phenomena. UIRF-Net makes the deep learning network more lightweight by using modules such as channel extraction prior information and RGB three-channel color enhancement, improving the image color while ensuring the image quality and processing speed. Through experiments on the UIEB-Withsnow dataset, it is verified that UIRF-Net can produce clear underwater images from photos containing complex marine snow noise. This study provides a comprehensive enhancement solution for the field of underwater image restoration, which significantly improves the clarity of underwater photos.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Resource Allocation Method Based on Federated Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the increase in the number of smart devices, the data generated is growing exponentially, leading to a large amount of data flowing to the cloud and causing congestion in core network communication. Edge computing can effectively reduce the burden of the core network, but there are still challenges in resource allocation between edge nodes and cloud centers. A method based on federated learning and reinforcement learning (FLRL) has been proposed to address this issue, and the server and edge hosts jointly formulate resource allocation strategies, which is beneficial for the global system. Experiments have shown that this method outperforms traditional deep reinforcement learning algorithms in terms of system average utility, average time step, and average resource utilization.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Time Series Based on SSA-LASSO
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of time series anomaly detection and classification, aiming at the problem of large feature dimensions of high-dimensional data, on the basis of studying the traditional feature selection algorithm of Lasso (Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator), combining Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) to optimize the Lasso feature selection algorithm, by optimizing the regularization parameters of Lasso and combining the strength of maximizing the penalty weight, improves the stability of the traditional LASSO algorithm in feature selection and effectively improves the robustness of the model. When LASSO performs feature selection, it retains the feature items with high coefficient correlation. At the same time, it uses the SSA algorithm to optimize LASSO feature selection to avoid the overfitting problem caused by too many features, so as to achieve the optimization ability of feature selection and the accuracy of classification. The Python experimental results have verified that this method can effectively improve the accuracy of classification.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Bulletproof Performance Based on LS-DYNA Composite Target Plate
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Based on the properties of different bulletproof materials, a composite target plate with structure of polyurethane/aluminum foam/rubber /Kevlar/TC4 is designed in this paper. By using the finite element analysis software ANSYS/LS-DYNA, Lagrange algorithm was selected to simulate the process of bullet penetration into the target plate, and the bulletproof performance of the composite target plate was analyzed from the aspects of bullet velocity attenuation and target plate damage. The simulation results show that the composite target plate with polyurethane/aluminum foam/rubber /Kevlar/TC4 structure meets the second level protection standard of the national police body armor standard GA 141-2010.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of the Factors Influencing Rock Crushing by High Voltage Electrical Pulses
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to explore the influencing factors of high-voltage electric pulse fracture rock, the COMSOL Multiphysics® simulation software was used to establish a strong pulse discharge rock cracking model, and the influence of pulse voltage, electrode spacing, rock properties and insulating fluid on high-voltage pulse fractured rock was explored through the internal electric field strength and crushing effect of the rock. The results show that the crushing effect of rock is best when the insulating fluid is transformer oil, and the rock is more easily broken with the increase of voltage. At the same time, the electrode spacing is inversely proportional to the rock crushing effect. The effect of rock properties on its fragmentation is not worth mentioning; In addition, the crushing effect of conical discharge electrode is better.

articleTitle: Research on Video Frame Insertion Method of Complex
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Currently, the primary video frame interpolation algorithm leveraging deep learning encounters difficulties in accurately extracting key information from two adjacent frames to perform motion estimation, particularly when dealing with complex motion scenarios. This often leads to the generation of frames containing artifacts in regions with intricate movements. To address the aforementioned challenges, this paper introduces a novel video frame insertion algorithm that incorporates spatiotemporal attention mechanisms, which uses 3D convolution to extract timing information and spatial features [1], uses spatiotemporal attention module to capture the interdependency of time and spatial dimensions between frames, finds the area most closely related to complex motion in the input frame, and carries out global modeling of complex motion. The desired intermediate frame is obtained by blending multi-scale spatial features. Moreover, distillation learning is used to compress the model, improve the training speed and generalization ability, and simultaneously solve the problems of too large model parameters, high memory consumption and difficult to be widely used. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively achieves rapid and high-quality frame insertion, surpassing existing algorithms in terms of computing resource efficiency while maintaining superior accuracy.

articleTitle: Video Human Action Analysis Based on Improved SlowFast Model Using Action Quantization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the surveillance camera relies on the site monitoring of personnel in the real shopping mall scene, based on the in-depth study of the SlowFast network structure and ResNet network, the SE (Squeeze and Extension) module (SE-RES) is introduced into ResNet. This paper proposes an improved SlowFast network architecture (SE-SlowFast). Using the optimized network structure, action groups are obtained through extensive video analysis using real mall surveillance videos as input sources. This paper proposed a method to quantify the action, and used the action group to analyze the relationship between the actions, so as to further show the action more intuitively in the surveillance video, so as to realize the extraction and analysis of abnormal segments in the surveillance video. This experiment gives the results of quantifying some actions, which is more intuitive compared to the traditional visual observation. This method can provide auxiliary services for surveillance video detection personnel, and greatly improve work efficiency and intelligence level.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Learning-Based Fault Diagnosis and Prediction Techniques for Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Due to the diversity and heterogeneity of electrical equipment, the operation monitoring systems for power transformers are undergoing diversified development. By utilizing machine learning methods, this study focuses on the prediction and diagnosis of heterogeneous terminal data from power transformers to address the challenges of online monitoring. This research is of significant importance for achieving the interconnection of all components in the power system and maintaining its operational stability. The study adopts machine learning techniques to comprehensively analyze the heterogeneous terminal data of power transformers, considering seven electrical energy parameters and four environmental parameters as the main input variables for the experimental analysis. A weighted least squares support vector machine algorithm based on chemical reaction optimization is proposed for parameter prediction in power transformers. Through a detailed comparative analysis during the simulation process, with a focus on evaluating regression algorithm performance metrics, the simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can rapidly and accurately predict parameter values for future time intervals.

articleTitle: Image Super-Resolution Reconstruction Based on Holistic Attention Dual Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: When addressing the challenges of an excessively large solution space and the difficulties in channel attention mechanisms to restore texture details during the generation of High-Resolution (HR) images from Low-Resolution (LR) images, an image super-resolution reconstruction algorithm based on the Holistic Residual Attention Dual Network (HRADN) is proposed. The use of a Dual Regression Network (DRN) with additional mappings is employed to estimate the downsampling kernel and impose constraints on the LR images, thereby reducing the solution space of functions. The incorporation of the Layer Attention Module (LAM) and Channel-Spatial Attention Module (CSAM) explores the correlations between different modules in the network and uncovers deeper information within the training data. Experimental evaluations conducted on five benchmark datasets have shown that the proposed algorithm outperforms several prevalent models in terms of Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), indicating its superior performance in super-resolution reconstruction. It significantly improves the clarity of details and reconstructs sharper high-frequency textures in subjective visual effects.

articleTitle: Visual SLAM Indoor 3D Map Construction Based on Kinect V1 Camera
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The visual SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) algorithm is widely used in fields such as unmanned driving, robot cruising, and VR, and there is an urgent need to conduct in-depth research on the three-dimensional mapping of the visual SLAM algorithm in various scenarios. For the problem of 3D mapping in indoor environments, the point cloud data collected by the Kinect V1 camera XBOX360 is processed. Based on the ROS system, ORB algorithm is used for extracting feature points, and the Iterative Closest Point algorithm (ICP) is used for map construction, and dense point cloud mapping is performed using existing datasets to achieve a complete 3D map construction of the indoor environment.

articleTitle: Research on online measurement method of fuse parts diameter based on laser projection method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to effectively shorten the time for online measurement of the diameter of fuzed parts by laser projection method, this paper designs a simple and effective diameter solving method - analytical approximation triangle method, and simulates the influence of parameters such as the position of the laser source and the position of the measurement center on the measurement results of the diameter of a certain fuzed part in the measurement process. The simulation results show that when the analytical approximate triangle method is used to solve the diameter of a fuse component measured online by laser projection, the distance between the laser source and the measured component should be increased appropriately, and the distance between the CCD panel and the measured component should be reduced.

articleTitle: Research and Application of a Question and Answer System for Bidding Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the amount of bidding data is increasing and the relevant data is not easy to query, deep learning and other related technologies are used to solve the problem. Firstly, the content of the bid-winning announcement was crawled through crawler technology, and the obtained text data was cleaned and other processing, and the named entity recognition was carried out by constructing the BERT, BILSTM, and CRF fusion models. Experiments are carried out on the self-made bid-winning announcement dataset to prove that the proposed method can identify long sequence entities such as company names and improve the accuracy of entity recognition. Then, the Neo4j graph database was used for data storage and visualization to complete the construction of the graph. Finally, a Q&A system platform was built to achieve the effect of intelligent Q&A.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Feature Extraction Channel Equalization Method Based on Res2net Module
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Under the condition of time-varying multi-path channel, to address traditional channel equalization methods cannot effectively eliminate Inter Symbol Interference, a multi-scale feature extraction channel equalization method based on Res2net module is proposed. The method adopts Res2net network technology, firstly, multi-scale feature extraction is carried out in the high dimensional space for the components of the received signal that are subject to ISI, then the reconstruction of the interference signal is completed by the extracted multi-scale features, and finally, based on the idea of residual difference, the reconstructed interference signal is used to correct and compensate the received signal in order to achieve the channel equalization, which reduces the bit error rate of the communication system and improves the reliability of the transmission of the communication system. Simulation results show that, compared with the traditional channel equalization method, the proposed method reduces the bit error rate by 6% in the Gaussian white noise channel environment and 3% in the colored noise channel environment under the multi-path Rayleigh channel.

articleTitle: A Chinese-Japanese Parallel Corpus for Neural Machine Translation Based on Web-Crawled News Data
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Current research on Japanese-Chinese parallel corpora is limited, particularly in the general field, and existing corpora are often small in scale. The purpose of this study is to fill this gap by constructing a large scale of Chinese-Japanese parallel corpus, sourced from web-crawled online news data. We also evaluated the quality of the constructed Web Crawled Corpus of Japanese and Chinese News (WCC-JCN), which comprised approximately 660K Chinese-Japanese sentence pairs, by calculating its BLEU scores and comparing it with the established ASPEC-JC corpus. The WCC-JCN is made freely available for download, provided it is used for research purposes only, thereby contributing to future research in this area.

articleTitle: Research on Exam Behavior Recognition Based on Efficientnet Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This article addresses issues such as poor real-time recognition of student exam behavior and difficulty in detecting small targets.Firstly, the attention CBAM module is introduced to perform attention operations in both spatial and channel dimensions, making the model more focused on the target object.Secondly, the feature fusion module is improved in Efficientnet to enable the model to obtain more small target features and further enhance its ability to detect small targets; Based on these optimization methods, a new object detection model EfficientZet-L-S was developed, and automatic recognition experiments were conducted using simulated exam scene video data.The average accuracy of identifying inappropriate behavior in the examination room increased from 75.6% to 81.3%.

articleTitle: Ice Scoop Block Texture Segmentation Method Based on Deeplabv3+
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In response to the issues of poor robustness and low detection efficiency of conventional ice scoop defect detection algorithms, this paper proposes an improved Deeplabv3+ ice scoop defect detection algorithm, which is used for the detection of black knots and pollution blocks on ice scoops. The new model replaces the feature extraction network with Mobilenetv2 to decrease the parameters and adds Bisnetv1 feature fusion module to enhance the combination of shallow feature and deep feature. To verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, experiments were conducted using a self-made dataset. The experimental results showed that the MIoU (Mean Intersection over Union) of the improved Deeplabv3+ on the test set reaches 80.89% and the parameters is only 9.8% of original model, making it more suitable for use in ice scoop detection systems.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Feature Networks for Signal Noise Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The modern wireless communication, the complexity and variability of background noise render traditional denoising methods inadequate for practical applications. To address this issue, a method to denoise at the base of a multi-scale characteristic network is proposed. This method, without any prior information, initially utilizes the nonlinear expressive power and feature extraction capabilities of deep neural networks to estimate background noise from multiple scales in a high-dimensional space. Subsequently, following the residual concept, it accomplishes denoising of the signal in this high-dimensional space and finally restores the signal to a low-dimensional space. Simulation results demonstrate the superiority of our denoising method over existing deep neural network-based denoising methods.

articleTitle: Industrial CT Truncated Projection Data Reconstruction System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In industry, Computer Tomography (CT) is a key technology used for non-destructive testing and evaluation of internal structures, but significant challenges remain in the processing of truncated projection data. The aim of this study is to investigate an artificial intelligence-based reconstruction system for industrial CT truncated projection data. We investigate the common data truncation problem in industrial CT technology and propose a new data reconstruction method. The method uses the ideas of full variance minimization and segmentation constants to achieve accurate reconstruction of truncated projection data by means of parallel computation. Our study validates the effectiveness and superiority of the method through comparative experiments. Compared with conventional methods, our system excels in both accuracy and stability of reconstruction results, and is better able to handle the challenges posed by truncated data. In addition, we explore the practical application value of the system, demonstrating its potential use in industrial CT. From a single-core to a dual-core processor, the processing time is reduced from 120 to 60 seconds, showing a doubling of the processing speed, which indicates that tasks are efficiently distributed and executed among multiple cores. The research results in this paper will have a positive impact on the development and application of industrial CT technology and promote its wide application in industrial production and quality control.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning Based Badminton Players' Movement Analysis Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This research utilizes human posture estimating technology to feather motion capture to overcome the issues of low precision of motion evaluation and inadequate real-time performance in classic motion capture analysis approaches. The evaluation of standard degree and the identification of badminton swing are examined in badminton instruction. First, a simplified OpenPose-based lightweight human posture estimation model is put forth: The 7x7 convolutional kernel structure inside the model is modified to a 7x7 convolutional kernel structure, and the lightweight MobileNet network replaces the Visual Geometry Group19(VGG19) feature extraction network. The model was constructed as a tandem structure with a 1×1 convolution, a 3×3 depth-separable convolution, and a null convolution with an expansion coefficient of 2. Test results indicate that the OpenPose model, which is lightweight, increases performance threefold and increases the accuracy of bone point recognition on the human arm by 3.57%.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of the Effect of Conical-disc Wave-Shaper on Jet Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To study the influence of wave-shaped on the jetting performance and penetration capability of shaped charges, nonlinear dynamic simulation software AUTODYN-2D was employed to simulate and calculate the effect of wave-shaper diameter on jetting performance. The results showed that increasing the wave-shaper diameter was beneficial for enhancing jet velocity, demonstrating that altering the wave-shaper dimensions can affect jetting performance. Subsequently, the primary and secondary influencing relationships between wave-shaped diameter (d), wave-shaped thickness (H), and stand-off height (S) on jetting were investigated using an orthogonal experimental design. The results indicated that wave-shaped diameter had a greater influence than stand-off height and wave-shaped thickness. Furthermore, it was found that when the wave-shaped diameter (d) was 36mm, wave-shaped thickness (H) was 10mm, and stand-off height (S) was 10mm, the jet velocity reached its maximum. This study provides further reference for the design and research of charge configurations incorporating wave-shaper.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Method of Relay Node Trust in Wireless Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This thesis studies the trust evaluation method of relay nodes in wireless communication networks. The relay nodes of wireless communication network play a key role in the process of data transmission, so it is very important to evaluate the trust of the relay nodes for network performance and security. In this article, through comprehensive consideration of the node power, surplus energy and bit error rate and other indicators, a relay node comprehensive trust value assessment method, the method to quantify the indicators, and use the appropriate weighting them together, calculate the relay node trust value. Through experimental simulation and analysis, the stability and feasibility of the proposed method are proved.

articleTitle: Use of T1-weighted MRI in the Quantitative Feature Analysis of Breast Lesions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Breast cancer is a severe threat to women's health worldwide. Diagnosis using MRI with an appropriate automatic segmentation algorithm can help in the early detection of breast cancer. Automated image analysis aims to extract relevant information from breast MRI images and improve accuracy.The main aim of this thesis is to utilize a computer-aided diagnosis scheme that combines quantitative features from T1-weighted MRI using a database of 72 benign and 49 malignant breast lesions in analyzing breast lesions. The algorithm is separated into three major sections: preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification. Firstly, automatic breast region segmentation was performed using a straight-line fitting method, and two categories of features were extracted. Then, the features were analyzed using the unilateral, bilateral, and asymmetry feature analysis methods. Thereafter, the sequential floating forward method (SFFS) was used to select the most effective features.Finally, the extracted features are used in a classification task with a support vector machine classifier. Using the 3-fold crossvalidation, the unilateral, bilateral, and asymmetry feature analysis method based on T1 weighted gave an AUC value of 0.8074, 0.8300, and 0.8353, respectively. When all feature analysis methods were observed, the asymmetry feature analysis method gave the highest AUC value in T1 weighted modalities.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Behavior Recognition on Campus Based on Dual-stream 3D FasterNet
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In recent years, public safety problems frequently occur, especially school violence has become the focus of social attention. Slowfast is a dual-stream difference speed video detection network with a 75% accuracy rate in video motion recognition, but Slowfast has a long running time and insufficient accuracy for the application of school violence detection. In order to solve the problems of slow operation speed and insufficient accuracy of the Slowfast model, this paper proposes to replace the backbone network with the latest lightweight feature extraction network FasterNet. At the same time, in order to ensure the network’s ability to extract time information, the two-dimensional network FasterNet is designed in three dimensions and improved to 3D FasterNet to replace the backbone network 3D Resnet in Slowfast. The utilization efficiency of hardware is improved by 30%, and the overall operation time of the network is reduced by 20%. After the improvement, the average accuracy of the network is improved by 4% and the accuracy of fighting action recognition is improved by 5%.

articleTitle: A Novel Haze Line Prior Haze Image Restoration Algorithm with Refine Transmission Map
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With a focus on the problems of contrast degradation and color shift in image dehazing algorithms, we propose a line-ahead haze image restoration algorithm with a new refined transmission map and theoretically analyze its refined transmission map model. First, a compensation term for the illumination-sensitive transmission map is introduced to compensate for the effect of image luminance degradation caused by dense haze in the scene. Next, an optimization algorithm is introduced to regularize the transmission map and remove the effect of noise on the estimation results. Finally, the image is restored in combination with an atmospheric scattering model. Subjective and objective experiments show that the proposed algorithm not only has a high subjective dehazing effect, adequate brightness and high color fidelity, but also performs well on objective performance measures under different haze concentrations.

articleTitle: An Improved Unambiguous Tracking Method of B1C Signal
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The thrid-generation Beidou system adopts a novel civil navigation signal called the B1C signal, which employs Binary Offset Carrier (BOC) modulation method. This method effectively enhances spectrum band utilization and positioning accuracy. In satellite navigation systems, the tracking process is a critical step of signal reception. During the tracking process for B1C signal, the autocorrelation properties for multi-peak structure of the BOC signal, which can cause the traditional tracking methods to incorrectly lock on the secondary peak, causing tracking blur. In this study, an improved unambiguous tracking method relied on shifting combination of sub cross-correlation functions(SCSF) is proposed. SCSF method eliminates correlation peaks, except for the main peak, by the shift combination of sub cross-correlation functions and BOC signal autocorrelation function. Simulation results indicate that the presented method is superior traditional tracking methods with respect to ambiguity resolution, multipath resistance, and noise resistance.

articleTitle: Research on rolling mill hydraulic fault diagnosis based on GA improved ANN algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In view of the difficulties in fault feature extraction, nonlinear signal changes and large data volume in the current fault diagnosis process of rolling mill servo hydraulic cylinder, a hydraulic fault diagnosis study based on GA (Genetic Algorithm) improved ANN (Artificial Neural Network) algorithm was proposed. Taking advantage of the rapidity of artificial neural network fault diagnosis, the signal was normalized and put into ANN for training, and then the network parameters were optimized through back propagation learning to improve the diagnosis accuracy. According to the working principle of the rolling mill system, a rolling mill system simulation model was established to simulate the internal leakage fault condition of the rolling mill. The research results show that the use of GA improved ANN algorithm can effectively optimize the average error and data accuracy, and effectively reduce the number of iterations, indicating that the GA improved ANN method can be used to improve the performance of neural network calculations.

articleTitle: Modeling and Identification of MSMA Self-sensing Actuator Based on Hammerstein Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: A magnetically controlled shape memory alloy (MSMA) is an innovative smart material characterized by significant output strain, quick response, and high energy density. Under environmental temperatures, its shape changes can be controlled by putting in for a magnetic field or external stress. It is considered to be an ideal intelligent material for self-sensing actuator. The most notable feature of MSMA is its memory capability, which allows it to retain its shape after the external magnetic field and mechanical stress are removed. Additionally, it exhibits reversible characteristics, enabling MSMA to produce deformation output displacements and forces generated under the influence of a magnetic field. The input and output of the MSMA self-sensing actuator exhibit a complex nonlinear relationship. To analyze these nonlinear characteristics, a multivariable Hammerstein model is developed, with its unknown parameters identified using the sand cat swarm optimization (SCSO) algorithm. To address the issues of low precision in parameter estimation and dull convergence in the chaotic sand cat swarm optimization (SCSO) algorithm, an enhanced chaotic sand cat swarm optimization (CSCSO) algorithm is proposed. The cubic chaotic map is incorporated into the identification process to increase the diversity of the initial sand cat population and enhance the algorithm's capability to avoid local optima. The algorithm can improve its capability to evade local optimal solutions. Finally, the model calculation results are compared against experimental data to validate both the model's correctness and the improved algorithm's accuracy in model identification, effectively addressing the issue of model precision.

articleTitle: R-YOLOV4: Enhancing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Target Detection Through Rotational Object Detection and Feature Alignment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In response to the challenges of target detection from the perspective of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), we propose the R-YOLOV4 Rotational Object Detection Algorithm. Specifically, R-YOLOV4 replaces horizontal detection boxes with rotational detection boxes to improve target shape conformity and detection performance. Furthermore, R-YOLOV4 replaces the backbone network to enhance the capability of detecting small targets. It also incorporates feature alignment structures and orientation detection structures into the detection head to improve the alignment and classification-regression tasks for rotational objects and anchor boxes. Experiments conducted on the DOTAv1.0 dataset demonstrate that the R-YOLOV4 method exhibits excellent performance in terms of both detection efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Variable Step Size LMS Adaptive Filtering Algorithm Based on Convex Combination
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This study investigates the convergence speed and mean square error capability of the Least Mean Square (LMS) adaptive filtering algorithm, presenting a novel approach termed the Fuzzy Variable Learning Rate LMS algorithm based on convex combination. Firstly, in order to enhancing convergence speed, an enhanced LMS algorithm employing variable learning rate based on sine functions, denoted as the Improved Variable Step Size LMS Algorithm based on Sine Function (γ-SLMS), is introduced. Building upon this, to mitigate the steady-state error, the Fuzzy Variable Learning Rate LMS Algorithm based on Mamdani Model (FMS-LMS) is proposed. Finally, utilizing a convex combination framework, the Fuzzy Variable Learning Rate LMS Adaptive Filtering Algorithm Based on Convex Combination (cFMS-LMS) is formulated. Simulation results indicate that the cFMS-LMS algorithm surpasses traditional LMS algorithms in both convergence speed and mean square error. Furthermore, it shows lower computational complexity compared to LMS algorithms utilizing Sugeno fuzzy inference.

articleTitle: Image Defogging Algorithm for Smoke Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of colour distortion and low saturation that occur in pictures taken under smoke conditions, this essay proposes an photo enhancement algorithm for smoke conditions, which improves the visual quality and readability of the images by combining the dark-channel a priori de-fogging method and the Retinex algorithm. The processed images are also analysed and evaluated by subjective and information entropy, mean gradient, mean square error and peak signal-to-noise ratio to verify the validity of the algorithm in this essay.In this essay, the dark channel priori method and Retinex algorithm are combined and improved, which has the following advantages over traditional photo enhancement algorithms:1.The colour and details of the image are restored more real: the dark channel a priori dehaze algorithm is able to restore the real colour and details of the image while removing the haze, reducing the colour distortion and detail blurring problems caused by the haze. Combined with Retinex algorithm can further improve the colour quality and detail clarity of the picture, making the photo more realistic and clear.2.More significant image enhancement effect: The image enhancement method that combines the dark channel priori defog algorithm and the Retinex algorithm can obtain more significant enhancement effects than when one algorithm is used alone. This method of using two algorithms in tandem improves the visual quality of the image by taking into account the need for fog removal and colour detail enhancement.

articleTitle: Holt Double Exponential Filter Algorithm Based on Spatial Limiting
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In practice, for the Kinect camera is susceptible to the influence of light, distance and acquisition objects, resulting in the skeletal node data acquired by the camera will inevitably introduce some noise, making the node data deviate from the real value of the problem, this paper proposes a spatial limitation based on holt double-exponential filter algorithm for filtering data anomalies. The method first obtains human 3D skeletal data through Kinect, and then carries out spatial limiting processing for each data, when the skeletal node data exceeds the limitation of the amplitude, take the intersection coordinates of the spatial straight line and the sphere with the above momentary smoothing value as the sphere center, and the amplitude as the radius as the valid value of the data; when the skeletal data is within the limitation of the amplitude, it is believed that the data itself is a valid value, and finally the data after the limitation of amplitude is fed into the holt filter to filter the data. Finally, the amplitude-limited data is fed into the holt filter to smooth the data for prediction. The experimental results show that the algorithm in this paper can effectively remove the influence of data noise and provide a good smoothing prediction process for the data.

articleTitle: Spam E-mail Recognition Method Based on Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of spam E-mail identification, a neural network model based spam E-mail identification method (ILC, Inception-LSTM-CNN) is proposed. In this method, first of all, a convolutional neural network with improved convolutional kernel Inception module is designed to extract features from the mail text, and then the extracted features are passed into the LSTM layer to obtain context information representation, and finally, the binary output is carried out through the CNN layer. On two different data sets trec06p and uci's spambase, the proposed method was evaluated by using the traditional accuracy, accuracy rate, recall rate and F1-score evaluation indexes. The results show that: The proposed method is superior to SVM, CNN, LSTM-CNN and Incep-LC in each evaluation index.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Detection Based on PCA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the application efficiency of face recognition technology, this paper proposes a face recognition model based on PCA-SVM. Firstly, the basic ORL face database is updated to build a new face recognition database; secondly, the PCA algorithm is used to reduce the dimensionality of face features, and the dimensionality-reduced face features are passed into the SVM classifier for training; finally, based on The PCA-SVM algorithm establishes a face recognition model, and compares the recognition effect of the PCA model and the improved PCA-SVM model through examples to verify the reliability and accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Research on obstacle avoidance planning of explosion-proof AGV unmanned factory
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Explosion-proof AGV has gained increasing attention for meeting the demands of "man-machine isolation, machine replacement, and black light factory". Although widely utilized in unmanned factories for tasks such as transportation and workpiece handling, the dynamic nature of transportation processes, characterized by obstacles and path alterations, necessitates real-time path updates to ensure the smooth operation of AGV vehicles. This paper introduces the fundamental principles of the A* algorithm and proposes an enhanced version to address these challenges. Through simulations and experiments, various obstacle avoidance algorithms based on A* are demonstrated to be both feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Based Self-Organizing Network Approach for Positioning Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem where the deployment of multiple positioning systems based on Ultra-Wideband (UWB) technology is too close to each other, leading to mutual interference, we propose a self-organizing network algorithm based on the UWB positioning system. The algorithm requires that when a certain tag appears within the communication range of a base station, the main base station randomly generates a Personal Area Network ID and utilizes the network identifier to form a LAN for all modules within its communication range. Once the networking is completed, there will be no more communication between different systems. Experiments have shown that the localization system utilizing this method can effectively solve the interaction problem between different systems.

articleTitle: Multi-physics field modeling and simulation analysis of electrothermal microactuators
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the multi-physical field modeling and simulation of microactuators, this paper takes a dual hot-arm actuator made of polysilicon as the research object and develops a coupled thermal-structural interaction multi-physical field model based on the characteristics of thermal expansion effect. The dual hot-arm actuator couples three different physical phenomena: current conduction, heat transfer containing heat generation, and structural stress and strain caused by thermal expansion. A parametric geometric approach is applied to the object of study, which leads to the analysis of the effects of the thermal actuator when its dimensions are varied. In order to confirm the validity of the model, the in-plane motion thermal actuator is analyzed and the simulation results are validated by COMSOL.

articleTitle: Improvement of Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm Based on Chaotic Mapping and Levy Flight
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: A recently developed population-intelligent optimization method, the grasshopper optimization algorithm (GOA) has been effectively used in numerous real-world applications. However, this algorithm has flaws like poor convergence speed and propensity to enter local optima. A grasshopper optimization algorithm based on chaos initialization and Levy flying (CLGOA) was thus presented to address these problems with grasshopper optimization methods and to enhance their performance. First, the population is initialized using Sine chaotic mapping, which makes it more uniform; Second, adjust the position-determining parameter c and use it as the weight for the ideal location to balance the algorithm's capacities for development and exploration; In order to help the algorithm exit the local region and locate the global optimal value throughout the optimization phase, the Levy flight mechanism is introduced last. By selecting 6 test functions (divided into unimodal and multimodal functions) to evaluate the performance of the algorithm, and comparing the average and variance of 30 consecutive experimental results with other algorithms, it is demonstrated that CLGOA has strong optimization performance. The suggested algorithm CLGOA's excellent optimization capabilities were demonstrated, strengthening the algorithm's robustness and convergence capabilities.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on Key Technologies for Real Time Data Warehouse Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Real time data warehouse refers to a data warehouse that achieves real-time requirements in data collection, processing, analysis, and application. Traditional data warehouses mainly focus on batch processing tasks, which are difficult to meet the needs of real-time business analysis and decision-making. Therefore, real-time data warehouses have emerged.This article studies and practices a real-time data warehouse construction method based on Flink. In the specific implementation process, real-time log data is collected through Flume, business data is collected through Maxwell, and peak shaving and decoupling of data are carried out using message queue Kafka. Using the Flink stream processing engine, build a real-time data warehouse to collect data in real-time from large-scale data sources, and perform Extract, Transform, Load(ETL) processing, dimension modeling, aggregation, and dimension degradation on the original data. Store the processing results in real-time in the data warehouse. Finally, the data is imported into Clickhouse based on task metrics and visualized for display.The research objective of this article is to explore the design and implementation of a real-time data warehouse based on Flink, aiming to achieve rapid processing and analysis of real-time data, and solve the data processing and analysis needs in practical business. The test results indicate that the applied technology is correct, the software design is reasonable, and meets the expected design requirements.

articleTitle: The Industrial Internet Security Situation Assessment Method Based on AHP-CRITIC Hybrid Weighting
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The assessment index system for industrial Internet network security relies too heavily on expert knowledge and overlooks the impact of objective factors on situation assessment. This paper addresses this issue by focusing on the characteristics of industrial networks, specifically the impact of asset vulnerabilities and alarm events on network situation. A comprehensive weighted hierarchical industrial Internet situation assessment method is proposed. The final comprehensive weight is obtained using the least square method, combined with the supervisor weight calculated by the analytic hierarchy process and the objective weight calculated by the CRITIC method. Finally, a network security experiment center is used to carry out situation assessment, and the evaluation value is calculated. Experimental results demonstrate that this method provides a more objective and accurate approach to situation assessment.

articleTitle: Research and Application of a Graphical User Interface System for Peripheral Blood Cell Detection and Identification Based on Deep Learning Model YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the advancements in machine learning and deep learning technologies, significant breakthroughs have been achieved in the field of target recognition. This paper aims to research and apply a graphical user interface (GUI) system for blood cell detection and identification based on the deep learning model YOLOv5. The system enhances the accuracy of blood cell detection and identification by medical professionals, thereby improving diagnostic efficiency. This study mainly encompasses the collection and preprocessing of a blood cell image dataset, the training and optimization of the YOLOv5 model, and the design and development of the GUI system. Firstly, a substantial dataset of blood cell images is collected and subjected to preprocessing steps such as data cleaning and image augmentation to improve the robustness and accuracy of the training model. Secondly, the YOLOv5 model, based on deep learning target recognition, is applied for the detection and identification of blood cells. Then, the model is trained and optimized to enhance the accuracy of blood cell detection and identification. Lastly, a GUI system featuring a user-friendly interface and interaction is designed and developed. The trained model is then applied to real-world tasks of blood cell detection and identification, enabling medical professionals to conveniently use and operate the system, thereby improving work efficiency. Experimental results indicate that the GUI system for blood cell detection and identification, based on the deep learning model YOLOv5, can accurately detect and identify blood cells. This holds significant implications for blood analysis and related disease diagnosis in the medical field.

articleTitle: Low-light Image Enhancement Algorithm Based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Low light image enhancement is an important task in computer vision. The Low-light images can adversely affect more advanced computer vision tasks such as target tracking, image segmentation, and target recognition due to the presence of large amounts of noise and low contrast. Therefore, research on low-light image enhancement is crucial. To address these issues, this paper delves into the comparison between traditional and non-traditional low-light image enhancement algorithms and has achieved the following results:We abandon the traditional approach based on a priori knowledge of images and instead redesign a new network structure for low-light image enhancement with the existing theoretical foundation for Transformer. The network performs information extraction in the channel dimension of the image through self-attention mechanism and then extracts the shallow feature information of the image through Shallow layer. After fusing these two types of information, more advanced information is extracted to guide the final image enhancement. Experimental results show that the redesigned network structure not only achieves better results but also has improved execution efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Solution and Optimization Methods for Nested Algebraic Loops
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To improve simulation efficiency and accuracy of simulation results, point at communication errors and data transmission issues caused by temporal variability between simulation models, Using Kosaraju - Breadth Bidirectional search method to detect the nested algebraic loop structure in the simulation system. On the basis of studying the traditional solution method of nonlinear equations, the structure of Jacobi matrix in the imprecise Newton's method is adjusted by using the iteration between H and S matrix in the NPHSS method, the Newton NPHSS iterative method is obtained to improve the low efficiency of imprecise Newton's method for solving large dimension algebraic loops, and improve the efficiency of the algorithm. The error analysis of the Newton NPHSS iterative method and the iterative results of Newton method and inexact Newton method show that the Newton NPHSS iterative method converges faster and has less iteration. And the new algorithm was applied to the FMI simulation system constructed by Simulink, achieving fast detection and effective solution of nested algebraic loops, verifying its effectiveness and feasibility in practical applications.

articleTitle: A Health Evaluation Model for Radar Seeker Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: A large amount of experimental data has been accumulated in the production process of radar seekers. The discovery of useful knowledge for diagnosing and predicting the quality status of radar seekers from a large amount of experimental data is a fundamental issue in the field of radar seeker data analysis. In response to this issue, a health status assessment method for guidance heads based on data mining technology has been studied. In this paper, the application of data mining technology in the analysis of radar seeker test data is explored. The basic functional model framework for evaluating the health status of radar seekers based on data mining technology has been established. Finally, the health status of the radar seeker related products was verified. The validation results show that the model can quickly and accurately detect abnormal data, which can effectively evaluate evaluation of the health status of the radar seeker.

articleTitle: Traffic Police Gesture Command Recognition Based on Convolutional Neural Network AlexNet
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Traffic police gesture signal recognition is of great significance in traffic management and urban intelligent transportation system, this paper researches the automatic recognition technology of traffic police command gesture signal based on the deep learning method, in the process of model training, the training set is used to train AlexNet, and the model is evaluated by the test set. The experimental results show that the model achieves high accuracy in the recognition of traffic police gesture signals. Finally, based on the trained model, a traffic police gesture signal recognition system is designed in MATLAB platform to realize the gesture signal recognition function on local images. The system can be used as a practical application tool for gesture signal recognition in traffic management, providing support for improving the efficiency and safety of urban traffic command.

articleTitle: Small Targets Under Drone Perspective Based on Improved YOLOv5s Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Research aimed at the detection of ground targets using UAVs for shooting, the phenomenon of missed detections and false detections still exists, and the algorithm cannot simultaneously consider detection accuracy and parameter size. Therefore, this paper uses the improved YOLOv5s algorithm to further study the above problems. Firstly, a Simple Patches of Convolution-Mixer (CSPCM) is added to both the Head and Backbone network structures of the original model, which uses deep convolution to help better fuse the information of the two dimensions and achieve higher accuracy; In addition, a small target detection layer is set up in the neck to expand the perception field of the model, so that the algorithm model can be handy when dealing with small target detection tasks. Secondly, the lightweight convolutional network module GhostNetV2 is used as the backbone of the algorithm, reducing feature redundancy in channels. Finally, YOLOv5-CG was tested on VisDrone2019. The new model reduced the number of parameters by 1468493 and the model size by 2.4M, mAP@0.5 Improved by 4.1%, mAP@0.5 0.95 increased by 1.9%; The experimental results indicate that Yolov5-CG can achieve parameter simplification while ensuring improved accuracy, and can be better used for small object detection.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method for Fan Rolling Bearing Based on Improved ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper presents a fault diagnosis technique for wind turbine rolling bearings, utilizing Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT) and an Enhanced Deep Residual Network (ResNet). This method addresses the prevalent issues of low accuracy and slow speed in diagnosing faults in wind turbine rolling bearings. Initially, continuous wavelet transform is employed to generate wavelet images with time-frequency domain features, ensuring the preservation of temporal characteristics of one-dimensional vibration signals during convolutional processing. Subsequently, the Squeeze and Excitation Networks (SENet) structure, which is based on an attention mechanism, is incorporated into the residual neural network. This enhances the ResNet50 neural network, allowing it to train the wavelet image input model more effectively. Finally, the trained model is utilized for classifying bearing faults. The experimental results indicate that the proposed technique achieves superior accuracy and speed compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Phase Gradient Metasurface RCS Reduction Technique Based on Metal Mesh Microstructure
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Under the requirement of electromagnetic (EM) scattering weakening for the internal components in flight platforms, a phase gradient metasurface based on metal mesh microstructures is proposed to reduce the radar scattering cross-section (RCS) and maintain a high optical transmittance. In order to realize the EM scattering reduction, a mesh model based on the phase gradient principle is established, which not only improves the total light transmittance in the optical band, but also homogenizes the scattering directions of the EM wave. Results demonstrate that the overall optical transmittance is higher than 88.60%. Meanwhile, the RCS reduction caused by the meshed metasurface is more than 10 dB in the frequency band of 15.7~18.1 GHz. Moreover, the maximum reduction value is 15.8 dB. The phase gradient metasurface proposed in this paper has a great application potential in the field of electromagnetic scattering.

articleTitle: Parallel Offloading of Terminal Multitasking in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As emerging technologies like autonomous driving continue to develop, they bring a plethora of latency-sensitive tasks to mobile terminals. Traditional single-terminal, single-task offloading models result in considerable waiting latency for subsequent offloading tasks. This paper introduces MIMO (Multiple Input Multiple Output) technology and proposes a single-terminal multi-task parallel offloading algorithm. The algorithm enables the simultaneous transmission of multiple tasks within a single timeslot, achieving rapid offloading of computational tasks. It also considers the issue of transmission power allocation for offloaded tasks, thereby reducing the latency introduced by data transfer. Simulation analysis indicates that the proposed method performs better than other algorithms in reducing average task latency.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Multi-Channel Image Acquisition and Processing System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The deep integration of new-generation information technology and manufacturing is triggering far-reaching industrial changes. Machine vision inspection is widely used in large-scale repetitive industrial production processes. In order to solve the problem of the limited field of view of the machine vision inspection system and the obstruction of the camera view during the inspection process, this article takes the glue dispenser vision inspection system as the project background, and designs a high-performance and low-cost FPGA-based multi-channel image acquisition and transmission system scheme. The system can realize parallel acquisition, decoding, storage, display, and transmission of data from 4 image sensors. The OV5640 is used as the video sensor for video capture, and video data is cached using DDR3 SDRAM and transmitted to the host computer through Gigabit Ethernet communication technology. This thesis utilizes the advantages of FPGA in the field of image processing to perform real-time pipeline operations on video data, solving the limitation of video capture by a single camera and improving the system's real-time performance. Implementing multi-channel image grayscale conversion, filtering, edge detection, and stitching fusion in FPGA.

articleTitle: Experimental Research of Underwater Polarization Imaging Based on Image Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Underwater optical imaging technology is an important component of underwater target detection technology, which has enormous application potential in various fields such as marine resource exploration and maritime search and rescue. Due to the severe absorption and scattering effects of light waves during underwater propagation, the image quality of imaging results deteriorates. Therefore, ordinary optical imaging techniques are often difficult to achieve ideal imaging results in underwater environments. This article focuses on the demand for high-quality imaging effects in underwater optical detection. By utilizing the suppression effect of polarized light imaging on diffuse reflection light, an underwater polarization imaging system is constructed by combining polarized light with a polarization camera. Relevant validation experiments are designed, and MATLAB software is used for comparative assessment of image quality. The results show that using polarization underwater imaging has improved image quality compared to traditional underwater imaging.
