The images obtained through underwater polarization optical imaging can better reflect important information such as edge details and texture contours of underwater targets. Underwater polarization imaging provides a new feasible method for underwater operations and resource detection.

articleTitle: Prediction Method of Grinding Process Parameters for a Segment Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: A method combining knowledge graph and multivariate neural network is proposed to address the difficulties in predicting the quality of primary grinding and the large fluctuation of overflow particle size in beneficiation processes. Firstly, information was extracted from multi-source heterogeneous data such as worker experience, technical standard documents, and production specifications, and a unified knowledge graph database was constructed. Then, the knowledge graph is transformed into feature vectors using the word vector transformation tool word2vec. Finally, apply the constructed CNN-BiLSTM-Att model for quality prediction and output the results. Case studies have shown that the proposed model is effective and feasible. This method achieves the process of converting qualitative data into quantitative data and further converting it into qualitative output, providing a new approach and method for predicting the quality of a grinding process.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Underwater Continuous Explosion Based on AUTODYN Finite Element Software
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: IUnderwater explosions can generate strong shock waves and bubble radiation pulse signals, with characteristics such as high sound power, wide frequency range, and controllable sound interference duration. Therefore, this article uses AUTODYN finite element software to achieve a simulation of underwater continuous explosions. The results show that the initiation intervals of the charge and states of the charge have a significant impact on the subsequent initiation of the charge. The research results provide a certain theoretical basis for the study of countermeasures against interference mines.

articleTitle: LightGBM Bidirectional Feature Selection Algorithm for Time Series Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of high-dimensional complex time series, a LGB-BS Feature selection algorithm based on LightGBM is proposed. The algorithm first uses LightGBM algorithm to build an iterative lifting Tree model for the original feature set, and measures the importance of features. Then, two feature importance metrics are used to combine two-way selection strategy to eliminate irrelevant and redundant features and select the optimal feature subset, Finally, the LSTM neural network is used to predict the original feature set and the optimal feature subset, respectively. The experimental results show that compared with the original feature set, the LGB-BS algorithm can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of high-dimensional complex time series by selecting the optimal feature subset, and improve the problem of poor feature input in time series prediction models.

articleTitle: An Energy-Saving MAC Protocol for Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks Based on TDMA
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To construct an efficient and reliable marine Internet of Things, there must be effective and dependable communication between underwater nodes. However, the underwater acoustic channel has significant peculiarities, mainly characterized by slow sound propagation speed, spatiotemporal uncertainty, narrow channel bandwidth, time-varying multipath, severe channel fading, exposed and hidden terminals, and limited energy. To address these issues, this paper proposes an energy-saving MAC protocol for three-dimensional environments, aimed at ensuring successful reception of data frames while minimizing collisions to save energy, and at the same time, ensuring a larger throughput and lower latency. This MAC protocol is implemented based on TDMA, divided into three stages.

articleTitle: Parametric Rapid Modeling Approach For Bridges
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: As an indispensable part of the field of highway traffic, the bridge plays an important role in traffic. The rapid development of information makes parametric design widely used in different fields and has been deeply penetrated into various fields. Parametric design can accurately reflect the boundary constraints of each component and express it through digitization. This paper proposes a parametric modeling method of bridge based on QT platform, which can meet the needs of certain target vulnerability research means and has certain application value in the field of bridge strike of military defense.

articleTitle: Road Extraction from U2Net High Resolution Remote Sensing Images with Attention Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN) have poor modeling ability for global information and may degrade performance when processing target objects at different locations or scales, this paper proposes an attention-constrained U2Net (CBU2Net) high-resolution remote sensing image path extraction method. Based on the original U2Net model, spatial and channel attention mechanisms are introduced. Network model was tested on the Massachusetts road data set, and the accuracy rate, recall rate, Intersection over Union(IoU) and F1-score reached 96.72%, 98.71%, 96.55% and 98.25%, respectively. Compared with the mainstream methods U2Net and U-Net, IoU increased by 0.04% and 0.34%, and F1-score increased by 0.03% and 0.18%, respectively. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the introduced approach exhibits commendable efficacy, successfully enhancing the precision of road segmentation.

articleTitle: Research on Bullwhip Effect under Supplier Interruption Risk Based on Sliding Mode Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Supply chain disruptions, such as natural disasters, equipment failures, poor inventory management, worker strikes, and financial issues, can amplify demand fluctuations, known as the bullwhip effect, affecting supply chain stability. This paper explores the application of Sliding Mode Predictive Control (SMPC) to mitigate the bullwhip effect in the context of supplier disruptions. First, a dynamic multi-level supply chain model is constructed, covering inventory and order quantities at each node, considering demand fluctuations and disruption risks. Then, a sliding mode control strategy is designed, using an error sliding surface combined with a sign function and control gain to achieve real-time adjustment of order quantities. By integrating a predictive control model, the strategy optimizes short-term control inputs to reduce the impact of demand fluctuations. Simulation results demonstrate that sliding mode predictive control effectively reduces the bullwhip effect and enhances supply chain robustness and stability.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Reasoning Model Based on Negative Sampling Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In the process of training a network security knowledge graph reasoning model, a large number of negative samples are required to enhance the model's generalization ability and accuracy. Considering that traditional negative sampling methods fail to generate high-quality negative samples, which in turn affects the accuracy of the network security knowledge graph reasoning model, based on Knowledge graph embedding by translating on hyperplanes (TransH), we propose an improved negative sampling TransH model (INS-TransH). This model constrains the negative samples based on the syntactic rules between entities and relations, thereby further enhancing the quality of generated negative samples. It also applies a self-adversarial negative sampling method that calculates the scores of negative samples to filter out low-quality samples. We construct a network security knowledge graph using Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CWE) database, Common Weakness Enumeration (CVE) database, and Common Attack Pattern Enumeration and Classification (CAPEC) database, and use this knowledge graph as the dataset for the INS-TransH model. Experimental results demonstrate that the INS-TransH model exhibits improved knowledge reasoning capability, with enhancements in Hits at 10 (Hits@10) and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) metrics.

articleTitle: Research on Forest Fire Image Recognition Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Forest fire image recognition based on YOLOv5 has great development and application prospects in the field of forest fire prevention today, among which the target recognition accuracy of early forest fire images is the key. In response to problem of low accuracy in image recognition during the early stages of forest fires, this article proposes an improved YOLOv5 algorithm based on YOLOv5 algorithm, which is improved on YOLOv5 backbone network to achieve better accuracy in image recognition during the early stages of forest fires. Insert CBAM into C3 module in YOLOv5 backbone network and add BotNET module at the end of backbone network. A comparative experiment was conducted between the improved YOLOv5 and the original YOLOv5, experimental results showed that improved YOLOv5 improved the average detection accuracy in both small fire target images and fire target image features that were not obvious. This can prove that improved YOLOv5 method proposed in this paper has a certain effect on early image recognition of forest fires.

articleTitle: Research on Complex Street View Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The current street scene is becoming more and more complex, with high pedestrian and vehicular traffic and a large number of targets. Aiming at the problems that the accuracy of the current complex street scene-oriented detection algorithms is not satisfactory and the leakage rate of small targets is unstable, the intelligent detection algorithm YOLOv8s- for complex street scenes is proposed, aiming at the intelligent detection of multi-targets in daily street scenes. This study is based on the target detection model of YOLOv8s, proposing a C2f-DCNv2 module that can sample features flexibly; adding a small target detection layer in the head; and using the Shape IoU loss function. The improved algorithm improves the precision, recall, and average accuracy by 2.2%, 3.6%, and 5.0%, respectively, compared with the initial algorithm, and these experimental data validate that this study can have a good performance when targeting the detection task of complex street scenes.

articleTitle: Improvement of Small Target Detection Algorithm Based on SSD
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the issues of imbalanced target distribution within the dataset and the deficiency of high-level semantic information in the lower-level feature maps for small target detection, this paper proposes a small target detection algorithm grounded in feature fusion. The algorithm builds upon the SSD framework. To enhance the detection background for small targets, a data augmentation technique is employed, bolstering the model's generalization capacity for small and medium-sized targets. To augment the semantic information in the lower-level feature maps, a feature fusion module is incorporated, injecting high-level semantic data into the low-level feature map. Comparative experiments conducted on the dataset demonstrate the algorithm's effectiveness, showing improved overall detection performance and enhanced accuracy for small and medium-sized targets.

articleTitle: Negative Feedback Noise Suppression and Equalization Algorithm Based on DNN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Channel equalization is one of the important methods for addressing inter-symbol interference (ISI) in wireless multi-path channel. In fast-changing channel, nonlinear equalization algorithms with feedback are commonly used to equalize received signals. However, due to noise and other factors, the convergence speed of the traditional algorithms are slow. In order to improve convergence speed and reduce BER, a deep neural network (DNN) is proposed. The algorithm uses neural networks to estimate the noise, which is fed back into the equalization algorithm to correct the convergence speed, correct the filter weights, and realize the optimization of the equalization algorithm. Simulation results show that, the algorithm converges faster and the fluctuation amplitude is reduced.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Model of Gas Concentration in Power Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The research of gas concentration prediction model in power transformer oil is an important means to diagnose the fault type of power transformer. According to the gas concentration generated in the daily work of the power transformer, the gas concentration generated in the later power transformer oil can be predicted. According to the predicted gas concentration, the fault type of the power transformer can be better diagnosed in advance. Therefore, the prediction of gas concentration in power transformer oil is discussed and studied. For the gas prediction of power transformer oil, long short-term memory network prediction model, bidirectional long short-term memory network prediction model and gated recurrent unit prediction model are selected. Taking the hydrogen concentration generated by a power transformer as an example, experiments are carried out, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and RMSE of the three models are compared and analyzed to evaluate which prediction model has better prediction effect.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction Algorithm of Indoor Scene Based on Kinect Camera
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Real-time 3D reconstruction based on consumer-grade depth cameras often causes problems such as noise, redundancy, and inter-frame mismatches. Aiming at the BundleFusion real-time indoor scene reconstruction method, a way to improve the accuracy and quality of reconstruction 3D models is proposed, and the adaptive processing of frame blocks is proposed. Local dynamic chunking is adopted to reduce the number of mismatched frames and improve model quality and clarity. Experiments show that the scene data after frame block adaptive processing retains more available frames, which improves the accuracy of reconstruction effect.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Ultra-Wideband-based Indoor Personnel Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to meet the indoor positioning requirements of specific places such as factories, museums, libraries and shopping malls, a set of Ultra Wide Band (UWB) indoor personnel positioning system, which can be self-localized by the base station and self-networked by the system, has been designed and implemented. The system mainly includes the host computer, UWB base station module and tag module, real-time positioning tag coordinates through the Time of Arrival (TOA) positioning algorithm, real-time personnel tracking and positioning, but also can realize the historical trajectory of personnel traceability. This paper researches the base station self-localization algorithm and system self-organizing network algorithm on the basis of realizing the positioning function, realizes the rapid positioning of the base station coordinates, and solves the problem of avoiding the mutual interference of different systems.

articleTitle: The Application and Performance Optimization of LoRa Wireless Communication Technology in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things, wireless communication technology has become a crucial component of IoT systems. LoRa (Long Range, Low Power) has garnered widespread attention as an emerging wireless communication technology due to its long-distance transmission capabilities and low power consumption. This article delves into the key characteristics, advantages, and limitations of LoRa technology in IoT applications, focusing on the exploration of performance optimization methods to meet the varied demands of IoT applications. By analyzing and optimizing the performance of LoRa in IoT applications, we can better propel the development and implementation of IoT technology.

articleTitle: Research on Index-based Octree Neighborhood Particle Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper proposes an index-based octree neighborhood particle search algorithm to optimize the efficiency of neighborhood particle search in Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) simulations. Based on the octree search algorithm, the optimization uses an index-based octree to reduce the depth of search recursion. In view of the variable particle number and variable particle support radius in the jet fire scene, the adaptive particle volume algorithm is combined. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs better than the octree search algorithm when the number of particles is large.

articleTitle: Single Image Defogging Algorithm Based on Adaptive Exposure Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a single image defogging algorithm based on adaptive exposure enhancement to address issues such as blurred edges, color distortion, and dim brightness in restored images. This algorithm first uses a bright channel prior and a dark channel prior to obtain the transmittance, and performs fusion and optimization processing. Then, based on the atmospheric scattering model, the restored image is obtained. Then, adaptive gamma correction is used to process the darker parts of the restored image, and then lighting enhancement is used to highlight the details of the corrected image. The experimental results on the SOTS dataset show that the image restored using our algorithm has rich details, natural colors, and has also achieved good improvement in objective indicators such as structural similarity and peak signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Research on Maize Recognition at Field Parcel Scale Based on Improved U-Net Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Accurate crop identification and classification is the core issue of crop monitoring, which is substantial importance to master grain production and realize scientific management. To enhance the precision of maize recognition at field parcel scale, this study took maize as research object, introduced Convolutional Block Attention Module based on U-Net, and proposed the maize recognition method at field parcel scale based on improved U-Net network. The comparative analysis between the improved network's recognition outcomes and those of the original U-Net revealed that the upgraded version demonstrated the swiftest training pace and the most rapid descent in the loss function, achieving stability sooner. The improved U-Net network's recognition accuracy was 88%, which represented a 5% increase over U-Net. The improved U-Net network recognized crops more accurately, which offers innovative insights for improving the accuracy of crop recognition at field parcel scale.

articleTitle: Research on Encrypted Traffic Detection Technology Based on Fusion Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Network encrypted traffic is widely used in network security and management, which requires obtaining differentiated traffic representations from invisible content and unbalanced network traffic to achieve accurate classification, which is a great challenge. For this purpose, this article proposes an f model based on fusion attention mechanism. Convolutional neural networks are used to extract spatial features of traffic, and the spatiotemporal correlation features between encrypted network traffic are analyzed using the BiLSTM (Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network) method. SE (Squeeze-and-Excitation Attention) and CBMA (Convolutional Block Attention Module) are then used to reassign and weight the spatial and channel dimensions. Using the USTC-TFC2016 datasets, the network flow was split from the traffic level to the session level using SplitCap. Afterwards, generate a fixed byte image. Compared with a single CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and CNN-LSTM (Convolutional Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory Network) structure, the proposed encrypted traffic model based on fusion attention mechanism exhibits better classification performance in this paper.

articleTitle: Multi-Technology Intelligent Detection of Explosives
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Explosives detection has been a hot topic in international research in recent years. In order to improve the detection effect, this paper studies a portable intelligent detection method based on fluorescence and Raman detection technology. Silicon dioxide fluorescent porous films were prepared by doping graphene quantum dots, and nitroexplosives were detected sensitively by fluorescence quenching, and the trace detection effect was obtained. Explosives are detected in long distance, multi-environment and multi-mode by using Raman spectrum scattering effect, and the effect of portable, rapid and simultaneous detection is obtained. Combined with fluorescence-Raman dual detection technology, the information collected by detection is complementary and fused. Get more accurate and efficient information of the object to be detected, and use software to build an intelligent cloud detection database platform to intelligently detect different explosive molecules, so as to achieve the effect of rapid, sensitive, portable and real-time detection.

articleTitle: Device Virtual Connection Optimization and Application Method Based on NShape
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of intuitive, easy to operate and efficient in the training and teaching process of equipment indirect interface connection operation, considering the advantages of graphical teaching, simple, intuitive and efficient training, it provides a good solution for the generality and expansion of complex equipment correlation operation. Therefore, this paper presents an optimization and application method of device virtual connection based on NShape. Firstly, we analyze and design a set of graphics object and editing operation architecture, and establish the management mechanism of its kernel model. Secondly, in view of the fact that a single basic virtual connection cannot meet the needs of complex connection relationships (that is, "one-to-many connection"), this paper designs and implements an improved connection algorithm, which strengthens and encapsulates into a new component class on the basis of not changing the original basic connection class, so as to meet the needs of one-to-many connection functions between devices. The expansibility of the device virtual connection system and its practicability in the visualization of device virtual connection are effectively improved. The experimental results show that the method is simple and efficient, and the virtual connection effect is more intuitive.

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Control Protocol in Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Nowadays, satellite communication has the characteristics of long links, high delay and high rate. And in the process of communication, due to the asymmetry of the forward and reverse link bandwidth, the reverse link congestion problem results in the decrease of the throughput of the whole system communication. Therefore, the traditional Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) protocol can not meet the needs of satellite link communication. In order to adapt to the characteristics of satellite communication and solve its problems, this paper improves acknowledgement mechanism based on the Quick UDP Internet Connections (QUIC) protocol to make it suitable for satellite communication. In addition, a frame survival time mechanism is proposed to make the throughput of the communication system more stable in the case of high bit error rate. In this paper, the simulation is carried out on OMNet++ platform. The experimental results show that the method can effectively alleviate the problem of reverse link congestion and improve the transmission performance of the system in space information network communication.

articleTitle: Research on Classification of Malicious Code Visualized Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: With the generation of a large number of variant malicious codes in various forms, traditional detection techniques can no longer accurately detect these unknown malicious codes, and the malicious code visualization method can express the core of malicious codes in image features, which can more accurately identify the malicious codes. Firstly, we summarize the current malicious code detection methods, then introduce the malicious code visualization and the data set required for the experiment, and finally use the deep learning method to classify and detect the visualized malicious code images, aiming to test the effect of the malicious code visualization and a detection method that is based on the deep learning method, and help developing malicious code detection technology.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Pulse Ranging Fuze Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: This article designed a pulse ranging fuse with a transmission signal of 100KHz. By analyzing the working principle of pulse ranging fuse and combining with circuit design principles, the main module circuits and overall circuits of pulse ranging fuse transmitter and receiver were designed and simulated using Multisim simulation software to analyze the working performance of the fuse circuit. It has been concluded that if the gating device of the fuse system outputs a signal to the coincidence stage, the filtered reflected signal can also enter the coincidence stage, and the coincidence stage will enable the execution stage to work.

articleTitle: Improved algorithm for liver tumor segmentation in CT images based on U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of inaccurate boundary segmentation of liver tumors by existing algorithms, an improved model REEC-UNet based on U-Net was proposed. Firstly, in order to alleviate the problem of gradient disappearance and semantic information loss in deep networks, residual connection is introduced into U-Net network framework. Then, the ECANet channel attention network was added in the coding stage and decoding stage to improve the performance of the convolutional neural network. The training and testing were carried out on the LiTS2017 dataset. The experimental findings demonstrated that the proposed method achieved more precise tumor boundary segmentation and enhanced the accuracy of liver tumor segmentation.

articleTitle: Automatic Modulation Recognition of Communication Signal Based on Deconvolution Generation Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To solve the problem of low signal recognition accuracy and insufficient network training under the few-shot condition, this paper proposes a generative adversarial network modulation recognition algorithm based on deconvolution feature reconstruction, which uses a small number of labeled samples to generate signal fake samples satisfying convolutional neural networks. The simulation results show that under the few-shot condition, the average recognition accuracy of the proposed algorithm can be improved by 9.3% compared with the traditional convolutional neural network algorithm when the SNR ranges from -6 to 6dB. Compared with the traditional generative adversarial network algorithm, the average recognition accuracy can be improved by 2.13%, effectively realizing the signal modulation recognition under the few-shot condition.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain Anomalous Behavior Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: For blockchain transactions, how to distinguish normal transactions from abnormal transactions is a very critical issue. To this end, we introduce deep learning as a capable tool for abnormal behavior detection detection, and its excellent learning ability shines in this field. In this paper, we propose a deep learning time series Transformer model based on deep learning combined with ResNet (Residual Network) for anomaly detection and classification of Bitcoin dataset. The Elliptic dataset is used and the dataset is top-filled by manually crawling the latest Bitcoin dataset, and the Random Forest algorithm is used for feature selection, and finally 16 features are selected for classification. After testing under different sampling methods the Transformer model combined with residual network shows good detection results compared to structures such as single machine learning algorithm SVM (Support Vector Machine) and other deep learning models CNN (Convolutional Neural Network).

articleTitle: Based on Chaos Neural Network Vector Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: between current, voltage, and rotor position on the stationary coordinate axis of a permanent magnet synchronous motor is a common method for vector control of the motor. The online training algorithm of the network is simple, the system response is fast, and it exhibits good adaptability. Building upon this, a hybrid approach combining chaos optimization and gradient descent is employed for the offline training of the BP neural network, which is subsequently utilized for vector control of the permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Laboratory Safety Anomaly Detection Based on GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: For the sake of better monitor the laboratory security problem, this thesis introduces the outlier detection technology into the laboratory security detection, and proposes an unsupervised anomaly detection algorithm on account of generative adversarial network. The algorithm is trained with positive samples to detect laboratory safety anomalies, and solves the problems of difficult sample acquisition and high labeling cost. To settle the training question of generating adversarial networks, the optimizer is optimized and the learning rate parameters are adjusted adaptively. In order to make the network to be more cautious about the main areas in the laboratory, the channel space hybrid attention module CBAM is introduced to help the model be more cautious about abnormal areas in the detection process. Experimental results on self-made data sets diaplay that proposed method can enhance the anomaly test ability of the detection and improve the training stability.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Prediction Based on Firefly Algorithm Optimized Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To meet the demands of intelligent network management in increasingly congested network environments, high-precision network traffic prediction is crucial. In order to enhance prediction accuracy, a network traffic prediction model incorporating Firefly Algorithm optimized Support Vector Machine (SVM) has been proposed. Firstly, simulation is performed based on the statistical properties of self-similar network traffic, and the Firefly Algorithm is employed to rapidly search for the optimal parameters of SVM. With these optimal parameters, the simulated network traffic is learned to derive an optimal network traffic prediction model. Finally, a comparative analysis is conducted between the optimized SVM-based network traffic prediction model and the non-optimized model. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach achieves higher prediction accuracy in network traffic forecasting while meeting the requirements of network management.

articleTitle: Study on the Relationship Between Rock Porosity and Electrode Voltage Based on Digital Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In this paper, a digital image processing algorithm i s designed based on digital image processing technology to achieve accurate acquisition of rock porosity data, and the parametric relationship between concrete porosity and electrode voltage is studied in depth and verified through experiments. The results show that the pores have a strong distortion effect on the internal electric field of the rock, the more the number of pores, the larger the radius of the pores, the larger the distortion effect on the internal electric field of the rock; the higher the electrode voltage, the higher the rock-breaking efficiency, but the energy utilisation rate decreases. The accuracy of the parameter relationship between porosity and electrode voltage of concrete rocks under the same conditions was verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Feature Triplet Attention Based Sharpness-Aware Classification Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In addressing the issue of convolutional neural networks struggling to distinguish important features in image feature extraction and aiming to enhance the model’s generalization capabilities, this paper introduces a Sharpness-Aware Image Classification Network based on Multi-Feature Triplet Attention and designs a Multi-Feature Triplet Convolution Attention model to obtain channel feature weights and spatial feature weights from feature maps, allowing these features to interact and enabling the network to effectively discern crucial features. Additionally, it incorporates the Sharpness-Aware Minimization algorithm to seek neighborhood parameters with consistently low loss values, minimizing the loss and enhancing the model’s generalization capabilities. Experiments conducted on the CIFAR-10 and SVHN datasets demonstrate a significant improvement in classification accuracy compared to traditional neural networks.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Model Method of AGC Hydraulic System Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The research focuses on the AGC hydraulic system of a cold rolling mill in a certain steel plant.Abstract-We propose a model that combines transfer learning and CNN for fault diagnosis of AGC hydraulic systems. This model effectively solves the diagnostic difficulties caused by data scarcity. By using simulated fault data as the source domain and real fault data as the target domain, we utilize Hilbert to reduce data differences. Subsequently, CNN learned the fault features in the source domain, and then fine tuned the target domain data to construct a transfer learning fault diagnosis model, which was successfully applied to the fault diagnosis of AGC hydraulic systems.

articleTitle: A Chinese-Japanese Parallel Corpus for Neural Machine Translation Based on Web-Crawled Data from NetEase Cloud Music
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In machine translation in the field of natural language processing, film and TV subtitles are commonly used as corpora. However, their availability is limited, and the process of crawling and aligning these subtitles can be challenging. To overcome this limitation, we explored alternative sources for collecting parallel sentence pairs. In this study, we utilized a crawler to collect Japanese song lists from NetEase Cloud Music. We specifically targeted songs with human translations available as lyrics. After filtering and cleaning the data, we successfully collected about 700000 sentence pairs and constructed the WCC-JCL (Crawling a corpus of Japanese and Chinese song lyrics from the internet) corpus. We conducted extensive evaluations and experiments to validate the corpus’s effectiveness. The corpus WCC-JCL we crawled is open for free download by researchers, but only for research purposes.

articleTitle: Dynamic response characteristic analysis of quadruped unmanned platform
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: In order to explore the dynamic characteristics of a four-legged unmanned platform carrying weapons, the stability and response characteristics of the launching action of an unmanned combat platform composed of multi-degree of freedom robotic arms and four-legged robots were studied. Based on the advantages of four DOF manipulator and four-legged robot, virtual prototype of four-legged unmanned combat platform is established to increase the working space of unmanned combat robot. The characteristics of the four-legged unmanned combat platform were calculated by using the three-edge stability cone method and the response value simulation.The results show that the minimum stability angles are 0.89, 5.43 and 0.18. The disturbance response value of 0° direction is respectively decreased by 1.47% and 29.89% compared with 90° and 180°. The disturbance response value of high and low direction is increased by 14.29% and decreased by 34.64% compared with 90°. It can be seen that the stability angle coefficient is minimum value and the stability reach maximum value when the muzzle is backward.In the mean time, the disturbance response difference gets minimum value.

articleTitle: Research on Assembly Sequence Optimization Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: To address the issue of combination explosion in complex product assembly sequences, an interference matrix is established to characterize the assembly geometric relationship among components. The assembly stability is quantified using connection matrices and support matrices. Subsequently, a fitness function incorporating feasibility and stability as evaluation metrics is constructed to achieve multi-objective optimization. To prevent the algorithm from converging prematurely to local peaks, the inertia weight of the procedure is reduced nonlinearly, and the concept of mutation is introduced to improve the local search functionality. The feasibility and efficacy of the proposed algorithm in addressing the assembly sequence optimization problem are validated through a case study involving the assembly sequence planning for a control cabin.

articleTitle: Dual Generative Adversarial Networks with Contextual-Dropout and Pairwise-Terms for Dual-Phase CT Scans Synthesis in Rectal Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Multi-phase CT scanning has been proven to be a powerful imaging modality for colorectal imaging, commonly used for the diagnosis and evaluation of rectal cancer and plays a crucial role in preoperative localization, metastasis assessment, and postoperative follow-up of rectal cancer. However, multiphase CT images are acquired sequentially after contrast agent injection, resulting in significant local deformations between the images due to respiratory and cardiac motion. And the current common registration methods hinder the effective implementation of computer-aided diagnosis using fused multi-phase CT data. In this paper, we present a dual-phase CT scan registration method to establish anatomical correspondence between multi-phase CT images, thereby enhancing the potential for conducting relevant research on rectal cancer diagnosis through the fusion of multiphase CT data. Specifically, we assess the feasibility of utilizing contextual-dropout and paired-item combination training in dual generative adversarial networks to improve the authenticity of the synthesized results obtained from the dual-phase CT scan synthesis approach. We validated our method using a set of dual-phase CT scan data comprising 107 patients with rectal cancer. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed approach effectively reduces the gap between synthesized and real dual-phase CT scans. This not only achieves accurate registration of dual-phase CT scan data in an alternative data synthesis manner but also enhances the potential of utilizing fused data from multi-phase CT for downstream computer-aided diagnostic tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Pin Defect Detection Algorithm of Power Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: A pin defect detection method utilizing an enhanced YOLOv5 algorithm was introduced to enhance the efficiency of UAV inspection on overhead power transmission lines and bolster the detection rate of critical device defects within the lines. Aiming at the attributes of a sizable image dimensions and small detection target of UAV, a cascaded three-level network detection method is adopted. ConvNeXt Block was introduced to build CNeB Block and replace some C3 Block in Neck. The RepLKDeXt Block was constructed in combination with RepLKNet to replace C3 Block in the trunk and Neck, and a depth of 27×27 separable convolution was used to improve the effective receptive field and higher shape deviation. A dynamic convolution ODConv was added to replace the Neck part of the Conv, and all four dimensions of complementary attention were learned using the multidimensional attention mechanism and parallel strategy. The experimental results demonstrate that compared to the YOLOv5s network, the enhanced model achieves a mAP@0.5:0.95 of 70.5%, marking a 2.5 percentage point increase, with an AP@0.5 reaching 99.5%. Additionally, the model’s computational load is decreased by 1, parameters reduced by 4.77%, effectively enhancing the detection accuracy of power transmission line pins while also improving detection speed.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Path Planning and Collision Avoidance for Smart Ships in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: The port and shipping industry urgently needs to accelerate the transition to green and intelligent technologies in the post-pandemic era. Ship collision avoidance remains a pivotal challenge in achieving intelligent navigation. This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning-based method for ship collision avoidance path planning in dynamic environments. Initially, a two-dimensional grid-based spatial environment is established to model ship domains, with collision risk levels assessed based on Automatic Identification System (AIS) data and the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs). The ship collision avoidance problem is formulated as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), wherein the observation space, action space, and reward function during collision avoidance are clearly defined. Utilizing this MDP framework, the Dueling Double Deep Q-network (D3QN) algorithm is employed to derive collision avoidance decisions. The algorithm incorporates prioritized experience replay and an adaptive decay greedy exploration strategy to enhance training efficiency. Simulation experiments are conducted across multiple encounter scenarios under collision regulations. The results substantiate the effectiveness of the proposed deep reinforcement learning approach for ship collision avoidance path planning.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Prefetching for Pre-record Live Migration of Virtual Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Pre-record is an effective method for live virtual machine migration. It predicts which memory pages are likely to be accessed and transfers them to the destination host in advance. It offers the benefits of short total migration time, short downtime, and low network traffic. In this paper, we further improve the the efficiency of the pre-record by optimizing the sequence of memory page migration. We utilize shadow page table to predict memory pages and quickly obtain memory access trajectories. A Shadow Record Table is created to prevent duplicate backups. We employ clustering algorithms to identify active memory blocks based on memory access trajectories. Pages in the active memory blocks are assigned priorities, and the migration order is determined based on these priorities. The results of the experiment on the Xen platform showed that our method can effectively reduce page faults based on pre-record, thus improving the migration efficiency and stability of load applications.

articleTitle: Overview of Research on Named Data Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: Due to the revolutionary development of computer network technology, the current internet architecture has also faced varying degrees of challenges. Therefore, Named Data Networking (NDN) emerged as a well-known and efficient ICN project funded by the Future Internet Architecture Program in the United States. It is a new type of Internet architecture based on named data, not a service. The core idea of NDN is to shift the focus of network communication to the name of the data itself, where the data is given a unique name, rather than simply addressing and locating through the host address. By using data names, NDN has achieved a more flexible, secure, and efficient information transmission method, providing a more scalable, secure, and inherently routing capable internet architecture, laying the groundwork for future research and learning on NDN.

articleTitle: Transit Underdetermined Blind Source Separation Based on ICEEMDAN and FastICA for Switch Machine Locking Signal
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Signal Processing and Intelligent Computing (SPIC)
abstract: It is the fundamental for achieving railway safety to ensure that the switch machine is fully locked. This article discusses a blind source separation method for locking the sound signal generated by the switch machine using the improved adaptive empirical mode decomposition (ICEEMDAN) and the fast independent component analysis algorithm (FastICA) in single channel. A new internal mode function component screening criterion is proposed based on the sound characteristics of locked signals. The ICEEMDAN method decomposes the one-dimensional collected sound signal into multiple IMFs. Then, based on the proposed screening criteria, select an IMF that meets both the correlation threshold and kurtosis threshold to form a new matrix. Finally, perform a negative entropy based FastICA on the matrix and select the component in the matrix that has the highest similarity to the locked signal spectrum as the separation result. A comparative study was conducted on various sound signal decomposition methods. The results react that the ICEEMDAN method selected in sound separation has better performance in indicators than other methods, including the spectral mean correlation coefficient (SMCC) and the kurtosis difference mean absolute error (KDMAE).
